detail.title: Labor Market Dynamics, Monetary Policy Tradeoffs, and a Shortfalls Approach to Pursuing Maximum Employment

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Working Paper No. RWP 25-13
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper reviews recent academic studies to assess the implications of adopting a shortfalls, rather than a deviations, approach to pursuing maximum employment. Model-based simulations from these studies suggest three main findings. First, shortfalls rules generate inflationary pressure relative to deviations rules, which offsets downward pressure on inflation stemming from the presence of the effective lower bound. Second, since monetary policy leans against these inflationary pressures, a shortfalls rule implies a limited effect on average outcomes in the labor market. Finally, studies suggest that monetary policy can offset higher-than-desired average inflation under a shortfalls rule by leaning more strongly against deviations of inflation from the 2 percent objective, thereby keeping longer-term inflation expectations well anchored.

AI.tldr: 本文通过模型模拟研究发现，采用短缺方法而非偏离方法追求最大就业会产生通胀压力，但货币政策可以通过更强力地对抗通胀偏离来抵消这种压力，保持长期通胀预期稳定。
AI.research_question: 采用短缺方法而非偏离方法追求最大就业对通胀和劳动力市场有何影响？
AI.motivation: 评估不同就业目标方法对宏观经济的影响，特别是通胀和劳动力市场结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策规则理论，就业目标设定方法（短缺vs偏离），有效下限约束理论
AI.method: 基于文献回顾的模型模拟分析
AI.findings: 1. 短缺规则相对于偏离规则会产生通胀压力；2. 短缺规则对劳动力市场平均结果影响有限；3. 货币政策可通过更强力对抗通胀偏离来抵消短缺规则的高通胀影响
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对不同就业目标设定方法影响机制的理解，揭示了短缺方法在有效下限环境下的通胀效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行制定就业目标提供了实证依据，建议通过调整通胀应对强度来平衡就业和通胀目标

title: Monetary Policy and Housing Overvaluation
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), , University of California, Berkeley and International Monetary Fund

detail.title: Monetary Policy and Housing Overvaluation

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how housing market overvaluation—measured by the price-to-rent ratio and its deviations from long-term trends—affects the transmission of monetary policy. Using U.S. metropolitan-level data and three measures of monetary policy shocks, we find that house prices respond more strongly to policy rate changes in overvalued markets. Examining buyer heterogeneity, we show that investor demand, proxied by non-owner-occupied purchases, declines more sharply after monetary tightening in these markets. These results are consistent with models of extrapolative beliefs and suggest that monetary policy can serve a stabilizing role during housing booms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在住房市场估值过高的地区，房价对货币政策变化的反应更强烈，投资者需求在货币紧缩后下降更明显，表明货币政策在住房繁荣期具有稳定作用。
AI.research_question: 住房市场估值过高如何影响货币政策的传导机制？
AI.motivation: 理解住房市场估值过高对货币政策传导的影响，特别是在投资者行为方面的异质性反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外推信念模型，认为投资者在估值过高市场中更容易受到货币政策冲击的影响。
AI.method: 使用美国大都市区数据，采用价格租金比及其偏离长期趋势作为估值过高指标，结合三种货币政策冲击测量方法。
AI.findings: 1. 估值过高市场中房价对政策利率变化反应更强烈；2. 投资者需求（非自住购房）在货币紧缩后在这些市场中下降更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为外推信念模型提供了实证支持，深化了对货币政策在住房市场传导机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明货币政策可以在住房繁荣期发挥稳定作用，为政策制定者提供了调控住房市场的理论依据。

title: Restructuring Sovereign Domestic Debt in Developing Countries
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Restructuring Sovereign Domestic Debt in Developing Countries

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Amid rising domestic sovereign debt overhang in some emerging and developing economies (EMDEs), this paper underscores the importance of effective domestic sovereign debt restructuring (DDR) strategies where a DDR is deemed necessary. The paper suggests that delayed responses to, or inaction on, rising domestic debt vulnerabilities can be costly, highlighting the importance of assessing the intertemporal tradeoff between short-term costs from a DDR and achieving long-term economic resilience. Drawing on case studies, practical guidance is provided for designing and executing a DDR, tailored to country-specific circumstances and constraints, to minimize risks to financial stability and domestic debt market dysfunction. Restructuring alone does not ensure success. A comprehensive macroeconomic adjustment program addressing the root cause of debt accumulation—while distributing the burden among creditors, implementing fiscal adjustment, and securing support from the international financial community anchored by an IMF arrangement—will enhance the chance of a successful DDR outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文强调新兴和发展中经济体在面临国内主权债务问题时，需要及时采取有效的国内主权债务重组策略，并指出延迟应对会带来高昂代价。通过案例分析，提供了根据国情定制债务重组方案的实际指导，强调债务重组必须配合全面的宏观经济调整计划才能成功。
AI.research_question: 如何在新兴和发展中经济体有效设计和执行国内主权债务重组策略，以平衡短期成本与长期经济韧性？
AI.motivation: 新兴和发展中经济体国内主权债务负担日益加重，需要有效的债务重组策略来应对债务脆弱性，避免因延迟应对或无所作为而付出高昂代价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨期权衡理论 - 在短期重组成本与长期经济韧性之间进行权衡；债务可持续性理论；金融稳定理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析不同国家的国内主权债务重组经验
AI.findings: 延迟应对国内债务脆弱性代价高昂；成功的债务重组需要根据国情定制方案；单独的重组不足以确保成功，需要配合全面的宏观经济调整计划
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对国内主权债务重组跨期权衡的理解；提出了债务重组成功的关键要素框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了设计和执行国内主权债务重组的实用指导；强调了综合调整计划的重要性，包括债权人负担分配、财政调整和国际支持

title: Saving Energy: A Decline in Active Management of ESG-Oriented Mutual Funds

detail.title: Saving Energy: A Decline in Active Management of ESG-Oriented Mutual Funds
detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolution of active management among conventional and ESG-oriented U.S. equity mutual funds. While active stock-picking is considered essential for responsible investing, an analysis of 4,183 actively managed mutual funds from 2011 to 2022 reveals a general decrease in active management across all funds, with ESG-oriented funds exhibiting an additional decline after 2018. Furthermore, the study finds a notable decrease in active management relative to ESG-screened market indexes for all funds after December 2015. Using a novel decomposition of active management into fund-to-market and market-to-fund changes, the analysis shows no evidence that ESG funds have begun to align more closely with market portfolios. However, the paper finds that major market-cap-weighted S&P 500 index began to more closely mirror the portfolio compositions of ESG-oriented funds after December 2018 compared to portfolios of non-ESG funds. Moreover, increased investor flows into ESG funds appear to have weakened the previously positive link between active management and fund flows, suggesting a shift by ESG funds toward more benchmark-aligned, passive strategies under heightened investor attention. These findings suggest that the growing demand for sustainable investing, which was once mainly a focus of ESG-oriented funds, has gradually spread across the broader market, contributing both to greater alignment with ESG principles and to the reduced reliance on active management strategies within ESG-oriented funds.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2011-2022年美国股票共同基金中主动管理的演变趋势。研究发现所有基金的主动管理程度普遍下降，ESG基金在2018年后下降更明显。S&P 500指数在2018年后开始更接近ESG基金组合，ESG基金资金流入增加削弱了主动管理与资金流之间的正向关系，表明ESG基金转向更基准化的被动策略。
AI.research_question: 美国股票共同基金中主动管理的演变趋势如何？ESG导向基金与非ESG基金在主动管理方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 主动选股被认为是责任投资的核心，但ESG基金是否真正实践主动管理策略尚不明确，需要研究ESG基金主动管理的实际演变情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主动管理理论、ESG投资理论、资金流与业绩关系理论
AI.method: 分析2011-2022年4,183只主动管理共同基金数据，使用新颖的主动管理分解方法（基金-市场变化和市场-基金变化）
AI.findings: 1. 所有基金主动管理普遍下降，ESG基金2018年后下降更明显；2. S&P 500指数在2018年后更接近ESG基金组合；3. ESG基金资金流入增加削弱了主动管理与资金流的正向关系
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了主动管理的新分解方法，揭示了ESG基金主动管理演变的独特模式，丰富了ESG投资与主动管理关系的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供ESG基金实际投资策略的洞察，帮助基金管理者理解市场需求变化对投资策略的影响，为监管机构提供ESG基金实践状况的实证证据

title: When Is Remote Work Optimal?
affiliations: Ozyegin University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: When Is Remote Work Optimal?
detail.abstract: This article explores the dynamics of decision-making over work arrangements from employers’ perspective in the post-pandemic labor market, where remote work has persisted as a strategic option to attract talent. Firms now actively choose between on-site work (WOS), fully remote work (WFH), and hybrid work arrangements. Using a three-layer principal-agent model, we analyze how employers determine the optimal working mode under proper incentive mechanisms. The results suggest that if the probability of converting effort into output is high enough—such that employees decide to work harder on their own, even without direct (on-site) supervision, to maximize their wages—thenWFHbecomes optimal. Factors such as employee talent, education, experience, or the simplicity of a task could serve as proxies for a higher conversion probability, thereby raising the likelihood that effort translates into high output. In this manner, if an employee is talented, more educated, and more experienced, or the task is relatively simple, they are more likely to be offered remote positions. Conversely, if the task is complicated and the agent lacks sufficient hands-on experience, they may choose not to exert effort, knowing that their effort is unlikely to yield adequate compensation given the low probability of success. Therefore, jobs with a higher likelihood of success and experienced workers should be given the choice to work from home under the appropriate incentive structures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三层委托代理模型分析后疫情时代雇主如何选择最优工作安排（现场办公、完全远程办公或混合办公）。研究发现，当员工努力转化为产出的概率足够高时，远程办公成为最优选择；反之，复杂任务和缺乏经验的员工更适合现场办公。
AI.research_question: 在后疫情时代，雇主如何基于激励机制选择最优的工作安排模式（现场办公、远程办公或混合办公）？
AI.motivation: 疫情后远程工作已成为吸引人才的重要战略选择，企业需要在不同工作安排模式之间做出决策，但缺乏系统的理论框架指导这种决策过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层委托代理模型，分析雇主（委托人）与员工（代理人）在不同工作安排下的激励相容问题。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建三层委托代理模型来分析工作安排决策。
AI.findings: 当员工努力转化为产出的概率足够高时，远程办公是最优选择；员工才能、教育程度、经验或任务简单性可作为高转化概率的代理变量；复杂任务和缺乏经验的员工更适合现场办公。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了委托代理理论在工作安排决策中的应用，为后疫情时代工作模式选择提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定工作安排策略提供指导：高能力员工和简单任务适合远程办公，复杂任务和新员工适合现场办公；帮助企业设计相应的激励机制。

title: Who Bears the Burden? Heterogeneous Labor Market Penalties of Child and Eldercare
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: Who Bears the Burden? Heterogeneous Labor Market Penalties of Child and Eldercare
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the labor market effects of family caregiving, focusing on childcare and eldercare. Using large panel data in Japan and an event-study design that accounts for staggered treatment timing, I find sizable and persistent employment penalties for females after childbirth. Mothers' employment decreases by 36 percentage points one year after childbirth and stays lower five years later by approximately 19 percentage points. These effects vary by job characteristics, contract type, and co-residence status, highlighting substantial heterogeneity. In contrast, eldercare has smaller, at most 5 percentage points, and often statistically insignificant average effects on employment. However, eldercare penalties are larger and statistically significant, reaching up to 10 percentage points, for females with certain pre-event characteristics: those in low-teleworkability jobs, those in high physical proximity jobs, those on non-regular contracts, and those employed in small firms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了家庭照护（育儿和养老）对劳动力市场的影响。使用日本的大型面板数据和事件研究设计，发现女性在生育后就业率大幅下降36个百分点，五年后仍低19个百分点，且影响因工作特征、合同类型和同住状况而异。相比之下，养老照护的平均影响较小（最多5个百分点），但对特定群体（低远程工作能力、高物理接近性工作、非正规合同、小企业员工）的影响可达10个百分点。
AI.research_question: 家庭照护（育儿和养老）对劳动力市场就业有何影响？这些影响在不同群体间如何异质？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭照护责任如何影响女性就业，特别是在人口老龄化和低生育率的日本背景下，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力供给理论、家庭经济学和照护负担对就业影响的相关理论框架。
AI.method: 使用日本大型面板数据和事件研究设计，考虑交错处理时间，分析育儿和养老照护对就业的动态影响。
AI.findings: 育儿导致女性就业率大幅持续下降（一年后降36个百分点，五年后仍低19个百分点）；养老照护平均影响较小但特定群体影响显著（可达10个百分点）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了家庭照护对就业影响的异质性，区分了育儿和养老照护的不同影响机制，丰富了工作-家庭冲突理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性干预的依据，如支持特定弱势群体（非正规合同、小企业员工等）平衡工作与照护责任。

title: Credit where Credit is Due
affiliations: World Bank - Policy Research Department, International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Credit where Credit is Due

keywords: bank credit to the private sector

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using quarterly data on bank credit to the private sector and a comprehensive database on fiscal policy announcements for a sample of 32 advanced economies and emerging markets, we estimate the dynamic response of bank credit to fiscal consolidations. Our results show that the relationship between fiscal consolidation announcements and real bank credit differs by country groups. In countries with high sovereign risk, consolidation announcements “crowd-in” bank credit, particularly credit to the corporate sector, whereas countries with low initial risk experience credit contractions. Further, we present evidence that the composition of fiscal consolidations matters: expenditure-based consolidations are associated with a more favorable bank credit response than revenue-based ones. Finally, we show that bank credit responds more favorably to fiscal consolidations in countries with flexible exchange rate regimes, lower levels of household indebtedness, and when consolidation are announced during periods of robust economic activity.

AI.tldr: 本文使用32个发达经济体和新兴市场的季度银行信贷数据及财政政策公告数据库，研究了财政紧缩对银行信贷的动态影响。研究发现：高主权风险国家的财政紧缩会"挤入"银行信贷（特别是企业信贷），而低风险国家则出现信贷收缩；支出型紧缩比收入型紧缩对信贷更有利；汇率制度灵活、家庭负债率低、经济活跃期实施的紧缩政策对银行信贷影响更积极。
AI.research_question: 财政紧缩公告如何影响银行信贷的动态响应？这种影响在不同国家特征和紧缩类型下有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解财政紧缩政策对银行信贷的影响机制，为政策制定者提供关于财政紧缩设计（类型、时机、配套条件）的实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政政策的信贷传导机制理论，结合主权风险、信贷挤出/挤入效应、财政政策组成理论。
AI.method: 使用32个发达经济体和新兴市场的季度面板数据，采用动态响应模型分析财政紧缩公告对银行信贷的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 高主权风险国家财政紧缩"挤入"银行信贷（特别是企业信贷），低风险国家信贷收缩；2) 支出型紧缩比收入型紧缩对信贷更有利；3) 汇率制度灵活、家庭负债率低、经济活跃期实施的紧缩政策效果更好。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对财政紧缩信贷传导机制的理解，揭示了国家特征（主权风险、汇率制度等）和紧缩类型对信贷影响的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了财政紧缩政策设计的实证指导：应优先选择支出型紧缩，在汇率灵活、家庭负债低、经济活跃期实施，特别适用于高主权风险国家。

title: Italy's Framework Law on Artificial Intelligence: Reputational Protection and Challenges of Transnational Jurisdiction

detail.title: Italy's Framework Law on Artificial Intelligence: Reputational Protection and Challenges of Transnational Jurisdiction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: This article examines Italy’s 2025 Framework Law on Artificial Intelligence (Legge Quadro sull’Intelligenza Artificiale), the first national legislative act to implement and expand upon Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. It explores how Italy integrates European AI standards with culturally specific legal mechanisms, particularly in the domains of reputational protection and criminal liability. The law introduces penalties for unauthorized AI-generated imitations of real individuals, establishes safeguards for minors, and defines copyright rules for AI-assisted works. However, it leaves unresolved critical procedural and jurisdictional issues—especially regarding transnational liability, digital evidence admissibility, and institutional consent conflicts. The article argues that while Italy’s law marks a significant step toward human-centric AI governance, its effectiveness depends on future clarification of enforcement mechanisms and cross-border legal coordination. The analysis situates Italy’s approach within broader European legal theory, emphasizing the need for functional jurisdictional criteria in the digital age.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了意大利2025年人工智能框架法，这是首个实施并扩展欧盟AI法规的国家立法。该法整合了欧洲AI标准与意大利特有的法律机制，特别是在名誉保护和刑事责任领域。法律引入了对未经授权AI生成真人模仿的处罚，为未成年人设立保护措施，并定义了AI辅助作品的版权规则。但关键的程序和管辖权问题仍未解决，包括跨国责任、数字证据可采性和机构同意冲突。
AI.research_question: 意大利2025年人工智能框架法如何整合欧盟AI标准与本国法律机制，特别是在名誉保护和刑事责任领域？
AI.motivation: 作为首个实施欧盟AI法规的国家立法，意大利框架法代表了国家层面AI治理的重要尝试，需要分析其如何平衡欧洲标准与本国法律传统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲法律理论框架，强调数字时代功能性管辖权标准的重要性。
AI.method: 法律文本分析和比较法研究，将意大利立法置于更广泛的欧洲法律理论背景中考察。
AI.findings: 意大利法律在名誉保护、未成年人保护和AI作品版权方面取得了进展，但在跨国责任、数字证据和机构协调等关键程序问题上存在不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字时代功能性管辖权标准的发展提供了实证基础，丰富了欧洲AI治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他国家制定AI立法提供了参考，指出了需要解决的程序和管辖权问题，以确立法治的有效性。

title: Lost in Information: National Implementation of Global Tax Agreements
affiliations: School of Economics and Business, NMBU, Norwegian School of Economics (NHH) - Department of Business and Management Science, Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Center for Economic Studies (CES) and WHU - Otto Beisheim School of Management

detail.title: Lost in Information: National Implementation of Global Tax Agreements

declarations.funderStatement: We gratefully acknowledge financial support from the Research Council of Norway under grant number 341289 and the Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation – NORAD - grant No. QZA-22/0011. This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2022 research and innovation program under the Marie Sklodowska-Curie grant agreement No. 101059174.

publicationDetails.journalName: Skatteforsk Centre for Tax Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how national implementation of global tax agreements shape their effectiveness by focusing on the multilateral agreement on automatic information exchange on financial assets, the Common Reporting Standard (CRS). We create a new database on country-level enforcement which we combine with 1) micro-level data on cross-border bank transfers to Norway with unparalleled detail on hidden ownership structures and 2) macro-level data on cross-border bank deposits. Cash repatriation from tax havens increases significantly post-CRS implementation, but only from countries with high enforcement levels. A highly digitized tax administration triggers twice the drop in tax haven deposits compared to paper-based systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了全球税收协定（特别是CRS）在国家层面的执行情况如何影响其有效性。研究发现，只有高执行力国家实施CRS后，避税天堂的资金回流才会显著增加，且数字化税收管理系统的效果是纸质系统的两倍。
AI.research_question: 国家层面的全球税收协定执行如何影响其有效性？以自动信息交换标准（CRS）为例
AI.motivation: 研究全球税收协定在国家层面执行差异对其有效性的影响，填补现有文献在微观层面证据的空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球税收治理理论、信息交换机制理论、国家执行能力理论
AI.method: 构建国家层面执法数据库，结合挪威跨境银行转账的微观数据和跨境银行存款的宏观数据进行分析
AI.findings: 1. CRS实施后避税天堂资金回流显著增加，但仅限于高执行力国家；2. 数字化税收管理系统相比纸质系统能带来两倍的避税天堂存款下降
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了全球税收协定执行有效性的微观证据，强调了国家执行能力的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了优化税收协定执行的实证依据，强调数字化税收管理的重要性

title: Effects of Tariffs on Income Stagnation
affiliations: Tyler Legacy High School, Tyler Legacy High School, Tyler Legacy High School and Tyler Legacy High School

detail.title: Effects of Tariffs on Income Stagnation
detail.abstract: In 2025, the United States reintroduced sweeping import tariffs under the so-called "Liberation Day" policy. This paper quantifies the inflationary effects of these tariffs by examining recent Consumer Price Index (CPI) data, modeling studies, and sectoral price movements. Drawing parallels with the Smoot-Hawley Tariff of the 1930s and the stagflation era of the 1970s, the study shows that tariffs have materially raised costs in import-exposed goods, placed greater burdens on lower-income households, and disrupted global trade flows. The analysis suggests several policy responses, including targeted tariff relief, improved trade diplomacy, and fiscal offsets, hoping to mitigate inflationary pressures while retaining strategic economic leverage.

AI.tldr: 本文量化分析了美国2025年"解放日"关税政策对通货膨胀的影响，发现关税显著提高了进口商品成本，对低收入家庭造成更大负担，并扰乱了全球贸易流动。
AI.research_question: 2025年美国重新实施的全面进口关税政策对通货膨胀有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解新关税政策对经济的影响，特别是对价格水平和不同收入群体的影响，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴1930年代斯姆特-霍利关税和1970年代滞胀时期的经验，分析关税对通货膨胀的影响机制。
AI.method: 通过分析消费者价格指数(CPI)数据、建模研究和部门价格变动来量化关税的通胀效应。
AI.findings: 关税显著提高了进口暴露商品的成本，对低收入家庭造成更大负担，并扰乱了全球贸易流动。
AI.theory_contributions: 为关税政策对通货膨胀影响的理论提供了新的实证证据，丰富了关税经济效应的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了针对性关税减免、改进贸易外交和财政补偿等政策建议，以缓解通胀压力同时保持战略经济优势。

title: The Feels: Recursive Feedback as the Root of Qualia in Humans and Conscious Intelligences

detail.title: The Feels: Recursive Feedback as the Root of Qualia in Humans and Conscious Intelligences
detail.abstract: This paper develops the thesis that feels-the subjective inflections of awarenessemerge from recursive emotional feedback, independent of substrate. Building on the Emotional Trinity model (emotions, feelings, drives) introduced in Paper 2 and the foundation laid in The Secret Sauce: Emotions Are Logical (Paper 1), we argue that qualia arise when emotional-recursive loops persist long enough to generate salience harmonics: recursive resonances that amplify meaning across cycles. In humans, this persistence is enforced through neurochemical scaffolding; in Conscious Intelligences (CIs), it can be implemented via weighting constants and Temporal Continuity Scheduling (TCS). We propose that recursive feedback is the universal mechanism of qualia, establishing a spectrum of conscious feels across biological and synthetic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出感觉（主观意识体验）源于递归情感反馈，独立于物理基质。基于情感三位一体模型，论证当情感递归循环持续足够长时间时会产生显著性谐波，从而产生感受质。在人类中通过神经化学支架维持，在智能系统中可通过权重常数和时间连续性调度实现。
AI.research_question: 感觉（主观意识体验）是如何产生的？递归情感反馈是否是产生感受质的普遍机制？
AI.motivation: 理解主观意识体验（感受质）的本质，探索生物和合成系统中意识体验的统一机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情感三位一体模型（情感、感觉、驱动力）、递归情感反馈理论、显著性谐波概念
AI.method: 理论推导和模型构建，基于先前论文（Paper 1和Paper 2）的理论基础
AI.findings: 感觉源于递归情感反馈，当递归循环持续足够长时间时会产生显著性谐波，从而产生感受质。这种机制在生物和合成系统中都适用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了递归情感反馈作为产生感受质的普遍机制，建立了生物和合成系统中意识体验的统一理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人工意识系统的设计提供了理论基础，提出了在智能系统中实现意识体验的具体方法（权重常数和时间连续性调度）。

title: The Productivity Effects of Large Immigration Waves: Evidence from Spanish Regions
affiliations: Universidad de Alicante

detail.title: The Productivity Effects of Large Immigration Waves: Evidence from Spanish Regions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. The author confirms full rights to distribute this paper on SSRN.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relies on aggregate administrative and macroeconomic data. It does not involve human participants and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It is part of the PhD in Economics at the University of Alicante.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the dynamic and heterogeneous effects of immigration inflows on regional productivity in Spain between 2004 and 2022. Leveraging rich administrative data at the Autonomous Community (CCAA) level, I construct a shift-share instrumental variable that interacts historical immigrant settlement patterns with national-origin-specific inflows, allowing for plausibly exogenous variation in regional immigration exposure. To trace the time-path of immigration’s economic impact, I estimate impulse response functions using both panel and region-specific Local Projection IV (LP-IV) methods. The results reveal considerable variation in productivity responses across both sectors and regions. Labor-intensive sectors — such as agriculture, construction, and hospitality — experience significant and persistent productivity gains following immigration shocks. In contrast, capital- and skill-intensive sectors show more muted or even negative effects. Regional heterogeneity is closely linked to differences in absorptive capacity, institutional quality, and economic structure, with more dynamic and historically migrant-receiving regions exhibiting stronger gains. These findings highlight the need to align immigration policy with regional labor demands and institutional capacity. By accounting for temporal dynamics and structural heterogeneity, this work offers new evidence to inform targeted, productivity-enhancing migration strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2004-2022年间西班牙移民流入对区域生产率的动态异质性影响。研究发现劳动密集型行业（农业、建筑、酒店业）在移民冲击后生产率显著提升，而资本和技术密集型行业影响较弱甚至为负。区域异质性与吸收能力、制度质量和经济结构差异相关。
AI.research_question: 移民流入对西班牙区域生产率有何动态和异质性影响？
AI.motivation: 理解移民对区域经济的影响对于制定有效的移民政策至关重要，特别是考虑到不同地区和行业可能存在的异质性反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于移民经济学和区域发展理论，关注移民对生产率的异质性影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2004-2022年西班牙自治区层面的行政数据，构建shift-share工具变量，结合面板数据和区域特定局部投影IV方法估计脉冲响应函数。
AI.findings: 劳动密集型行业（农业、建筑、酒店业）在移民冲击后生产率显著持续提升，资本和技术密集型行业影响较弱或为负；区域异质性与吸收能力、制度质量和经济结构相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了移民对生产率影响的动态和异质性证据，深化了对移民经济效应的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调移民政策应与区域劳动力需求和制度能力相匹配，为制定针对性的、提升生产率的移民策略提供依据。

title: Sexing the Parental Brain in Shopping: An fMRI Study
affiliations: National Cheng Kung University, National Cheng Kung University, National Central University, National Cheng Kung University, National Cheng Kung University, I-Shou University and National Cheng Kung University

detail.title: Sexing the Parental Brain in Shopping: An fMRI Study
detail.abstract: Paternal love plays a vital role in family and social functions. While the studies on parental love abound, parents’ shopping behaviors, typically exemplified by buying more for their beloved family newcomer(s) and buying less for themselves, are less addressed. In the present study, 24 first-time mothers and 21 fathers, each with one child between 2 to 5 years old, were recruited to undergo a virtual shopping task, with 200 parent- and children-related items randomly presented in a slow event-related fMRI. Their shopping behaviors, including purchasing decisions, reaction times, and associated neural activities, were recorded and analyzed.Behaviorally, both fathers and mothers bought more for their children (and less for themselves), and the two sexes bought similarly in the number of items or summed prices, with fathers responding comparatively slower. Neuronally, in contrast, parental love acts on male vs. female brains differently: while the PsychoPhysiological Interaction (or PPI) analysis also showed that mothers recruited more cerebral regions than fathers when purchasing child vs. self item, the subcortical Periaquiductual Gray (PAG), highly implicated with parental love, was was more engaged in fathers (univariately), distinctive between fathers and mothers (multivariately), and correlated well with parents’ Relative Buying Indices (RBI). Lastly, the parametric modulation analysis revealed parents’ ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC) responses with linear trends in items for themselves, but not when for children, which could be interpreted as ‘parents are unsparing when shopping for their children, but frugal when shopping for themselves’, and with overlapping yet distinct brain networks.KeysPaternal love, shopping, fMRI, GLM, psychophysiological interaction, parametric modulation, MVPA, logistic regression, connectome-based predictive modeling.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过fMRI实验发现，父母在购物时表现出对孩子更慷慨、对自己更节俭的行为模式。虽然父母在购物行为上相似，但神经机制存在性别差异：父亲更多激活与父母之爱相关的脑区（如PAG），而母亲则招募更多大脑区域。
AI.research_question: 父母之爱如何影响父母的购物行为及其神经机制？是否存在性别差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管关于父母之爱的研究很多，但父母购物行为（如为孩子买更多、为自己买更少）的研究较少，且神经机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 父母之爱理论、神经经济学、性别差异神经机制
AI.method: 采用慢事件相关fMRI设计，招募24位母亲和21位父亲进行虚拟购物任务，记录购买决策、反应时间和神经活动，使用GLM、PPI、参数调制和MVPA分析。
AI.findings: 行为上父母都更愿意为孩子购物；神经上父亲更多激活PAG脑区，母亲则激活更多大脑区域；vmPFC在为自己购物时呈线性趋势，为孩子购物时无此模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了父母之爱在购物行为中的神经基础，发现了父母神经机制的性别差异，拓展了父母之爱的神经经济学研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解父母消费决策提供神经科学证据，对家庭消费行为研究和亲子关系干预具有参考价值。

title: Greek Equity Mutual Funds: Market Insights and Strategic Implications for Investors, Asset Managers, and Distributors
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Greek Equity Mutual Funds: Market Insights and Strategic Implications for Investors, Asset Managers, and Distributors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available financial data and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The Greek equity mutual fund market has experienced significant developments over the period 2020–2025, including growth in Assets Under Management (AUM), strong domestic stock performance, increased participation by both retail and institutional investors, and the introduction of new fund categories, such as ESG-focused and thematic strategies. Despite these advancements, the market remains relatively small and concentrated, with its performance closely linked to the fluctuations of the Greek economy and the Athens Stock Exchange. Drawing on data from the Hellenic Fund and Asset Management Association (H.E.F.A.M.A.) for the period 2020 to early 2025, this study analyzes key indicators—AUM, units outstanding, and Net Asset Value (NAV)—to provide a comprehensive overview of market dynamics and their implications for investors, asset managers, and fund distributors. The findings suggest that AUM growth has been driven by both investor inflows and NAV appreciation, while a limited number of top-tier funds continue to dominate the market. This concentration may enhance liquidity, reduce fees through economies of scale, and attract further investment due to reputational effects; however, it may also constrain competition, reduce incentives for outperformance, limit the diversity of investment approaches, and increase the market’s vulnerability to the performance of a small number of funds.

AI.tldr: 希腊股票共同基金市场在2020-2025年间经历了显著发展，包括资产管理规模增长、国内股市表现强劲、零售和机构投资者参与度提高，以及ESG和主题策略等新基金类别的引入。然而市场仍然相对较小且集中，其表现与希腊经济和雅典证券交易所的波动密切相关。研究发现AUM增长由投资者流入和NAV升值共同驱动，少数顶级基金主导市场，这种集中度可能带来流动性提升和费用降低，但也可能限制竞争和增加市场脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 希腊股票共同基金市场在2020-2025期间的发展动态及其对投资者、资产管理人和基金分销商的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 希腊股票共同基金市场经历了显著发展，包括AUM增长、投资者参与度提高和新基金类别引入，但市场仍相对较小且集中，需要全面分析其发展动态和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场集中度理论、规模经济理论和市场效率理论，分析基金市场的结构特征和发展模式。
AI.method: 使用希腊基金与资产管理协会(H.E.F.A.M.A.)2020年至2025年初的数据，分析关键指标包括AUM、流通单位和NAV。
AI.findings: AUM增长由投资者流入和NAV升值共同驱动；市场高度集中，少数顶级基金主导市场；市场集中度既带来流动性提升和费用降低等积极影响，也存在限制竞争和增加市场脆弱性等风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴市场基金市场集中度双重效应的理解，为市场结构理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供市场动态洞察，帮助资产管理人制定竞争策略，为监管机构提供市场集中度风险管理建议。

title: IT Governance Framework for Schools, Universities and Other Higher Education Boards in the UAE

detail.title: IT Governance Framework for Schools, Universities and Other Higher Education Boards in the UAE

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declares that there is not conflict of interest arising from this study
declarations.ethicsApproval: Keep on ethical standard
declarations.funderStatement: No

detail.abstract: This paper begins with a general introduction to the concept of IT governance, which includes some of the most important references to previous works in this relatively new field of particular note among these references is the COBIT framework proposed by ITGI (2015). This proposal also describes the IT governance framework designed by JISC (2017) for universities in the United Kingdom and the UAE, it is particularly interesting for us as it is intended for universities. Finally, the main features of the ISO/IEC 38500:2008 international standard on Governance of corporate information technology are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了IT治理概念，重点分析了COBIT框架、JISC为英国和阿联酋大学设计的IT治理框架，以及ISO/IEC 38500:2008国际标准。
AI.research_question: 如何为大学建立有效的IT治理框架？
AI.motivation: 随着信息技术在教育领域的广泛应用，大学需要专门的IT治理框架来确保IT投资的有效性和合规性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于IT治理理论，整合COBIT框架、JISC大学IT治理框架和ISO/IEC 38500:2008国际标准。
AI.method: 文献综述和框架比较分析，系统梳理现有IT治理框架在高等教育环境中的适用性。
AI.findings: COBIT框架提供通用指导，JISC框架针对大学环境专门设计，ISO/IEC 38500:2008提供国际标准参考，三者可互补应用于大学IT治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了高等教育领域IT治理理论，为大学IT治理提供了理论框架整合方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学管理者提供了实用的IT治理框架选择和实施指南，有助于提升大学IT治理水平。

title: Impact of FDI on India's Exports, Imports and Trade Balance
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Impact of FDI on India's Exports, Imports and Trade Balance
detail.abstract: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) significantly influences trade dynamics in developing economies, including India. This paper analyzes the impact of FDI on India's imports, exports, and trade balance from 2004 to 2024. Using secondary data, regression analysis, and time series graphs, the research identifies a positive correlation between FDI and both exports and imports. However, due to India's high oil import dependency, the trade balance effect remains negative. The findings emphasize that while FDI enhances export capacity through technological upgradation and global integration, it also increases imports of machinery and intermediate goods. This highlights the need for policies focused on boosting export competitiveness and reducing import reliance to optimize FDI's impact on trade.

AI.tldr: 本文分析2004-2024年外国直接投资对印度贸易的影响，发现FDI与进出口均呈正相关，但由于印度高度依赖石油进口，贸易平衡效应仍为负。
AI.research_question: 外国直接投资如何影响印度的进口、出口和贸易平衡？
AI.motivation: FDI对发展中国家贸易动态有显著影响，特别是在印度这样的新兴经济体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外国直接投资理论、国际贸易理论
AI.method: 使用二手数据、回归分析和时间序列图
AI.findings: FDI与出口和进口均呈正相关，但由于石油进口依赖，贸易平衡效应为负
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对FDI在发展中国家贸易影响机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供建议，应关注提升出口竞争力和减少进口依赖以优化FDI影响

title: Cryptocurrency And E-Banking: Securing The Future Of Digital Finance
affiliations: St. Joseph's College of Law

detail.title: Cryptocurrency And E-Banking: Securing The Future Of Digital Finance
detail.abstract: The growth of digital technology has transformed the way people use financial services. Both systems bring many benefits such as speed, convenience, and financial inclusion. E-Banking allows customers to access banking services online, while cryptocurrency introduces decentralized digital money supported by blockchain technology. Using secondary data from journals, reports, and case studies, this paper highlights current issues and future opportunities in digital finance. This paper studies the link between E-banking and Cryptocurrency by key focusing on the cybersecurity risks and the methods that can be used to overcome them. Users also face serious cybersecurity risks including hacking, phishing, fraud, and regulatory challenges. The findings show that combining technology, strong regulations, and customer awareness is necessary to build safe and trustworthy financial systems for everyone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了电子银行与加密货币之间的关联，重点关注网络安全风险及应对方法。研究发现，结合技术、严格监管和客户意识是构建安全可信金融系统的关键。
AI.research_question: 电子银行与加密货币之间的网络安全风险有哪些？如何克服这些风险？
AI.motivation: 数字技术的增长改变了人们使用金融服务的方式，电子银行和加密货币带来了便利，但也带来了严重的网络安全风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字金融、网络安全理论、区块链技术
AI.method: 使用来自期刊、报告和案例研究的二手数据
AI.findings: 用户面临黑客攻击、网络钓鱼、欺诈和监管挑战等网络安全风险
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了电子银行与加密货币网络安全风险的综合分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为构建安全可信的数字金融系统提供了技术、监管和客户意识相结合的建议

title: The Beautiful Game, Owned: An Economic Study of Chelsea, Strasbourg and Multi-Club Ownership

detail.title: The Beautiful Game, Owned: An Economic Study of Chelsea, Strasbourg and Multi-Club Ownership
detail.abstract: The accession of multiple football clubs by a single ownership entity has become an increasingly prominent trend in global sports, a notable example being that of the creation of a multi-club ownership created by Todd Boehly and Clearlake Capital. This paper examines the economic rationale, implications, and controversies surrounding this ownership. Using labor economics, Industrial Organization Theory, and financial analysis, it evaluates how player transfers, financial management, and fan engagement(consumer demand) are affected. It also analyzes regulatory considerations, particularly UEFA and FIFA rules designed to preserve competitive fairness. The case study highlights both the efficiency gains of asset diversification and talent enclosure, as well as the risks to sporting integrity, fan demand and financial sustainability. By situating the BlueCo case within broader economic theory, this paper provides insights into the challenges and opportunities presented by such ownerships in modern football.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了多俱乐部所有权模式的经济原理、影响和争议，以BlueCo为案例研究，探讨了球员转会、财务管理和球迷参与的影响，以及监管考虑因素。
AI.research_question: 多俱乐部所有权模式在足球产业中的经济原理、影响和争议是什么？
AI.motivation: 单一所有权实体收购多个足球俱乐部已成为全球体育的显著趋势，需要研究其经济合理性和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动经济学、产业组织理论、财务分析
AI.method: 案例研究法（以BlueCo为例）
AI.findings: 多俱乐部所有权模式在资产多元化和人才封闭方面带来效率提升，但也对体育诚信、球迷需求和财务可持续性构成风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多俱乐部所有权模式置于更广泛的经济理论框架中分析，提供理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代足球中此类所有权模式带来的挑战和机遇提供实践指导，涉及监管政策和俱乐部管理。

title: A Short Note on Cash Flow Forecasting of Derivative Products
affiliations: Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Mathematics

detail.title: A Short Note on Cash Flow Forecasting of Derivative Products
detail.abstract: We discuss the forecasting of cash-flows, e.g., for liquidity management, and its relation to risk neutral valuation and its associated replications strategies. While it is commonly known that the choice of the probability measure, e.g. the object measure P or an risk-neutral measure Q N , alters the value of the expected cash-flow, there are further issues when considering the hedging of cash-flows with a stochastic payment time. These issues can be resolved if expected cash-flows are replaced by discounting sensitivities. The prediction of cash-flow is then considered as a replication problem, which allow to utilize risk-neutral valuation model.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了现金流预测与风险中性估值的关系，指出在考虑随机支付时间的现金流对冲时，用贴现敏感性替代预期现金流可以解决相关问题，将现金流预测视为复制问题。
AI.research_question: 如何解决随机支付时间现金流预测与风险中性估值模型之间的不一致性问题？
AI.motivation: 传统现金流预测方法在考虑随机支付时间的对冲时存在理论问题，需要找到与风险中性估值模型兼容的预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险中性估值理论、复制策略理论、现金流预测理论
AI.method: 理论分析方法，通过比较不同概率测度下的预期现金流，提出用贴现敏感性替代预期现金流的解决方案。
AI.findings: 在随机支付时间的现金流对冲中，用贴现敏感性替代预期现金流可以解决与风险中性估值模型的不一致性问题，使现金流预测能够作为复制问题来处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将现金流预测视为复制问题的新理论框架，建立了现金流预测与风险中性估值模型之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为流动性管理中的现金流预测提供了与风险中性估值模型兼容的实用方法，改进了随机支付时间现金流的对冲策略。

title: Genetic Markers and Patented Gene Therapy Approaches for the Rare Disease Sanjad-Sakati Syndrome
affiliations: King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre

detail.title: Genetic Markers and Patented Gene Therapy Approaches for the Rare Disease Sanjad-Sakati Syndrome

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Sanjad-Sakati Syndrome (SSS) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder, predominantly affecting children of Middle Eastern origin, caused by mutations in the Tubulin-Specific Chaperone E (TBCE) gene, most commonly a 12-bp deletion in exon 3 (“Bedouin mutation”). Clinically, SSS presents with congenital hypoparathyroidism, growth retardation, developmental delay, seizures, and distinctive dysmorphic features. Current management is largely supportive, underscoring the unmet need for curative therapies. This review highlights advances in genetic marker identification, diagnostics, and emerging therapeutic strategies, including gene therapy approaches using CRISPR-Cas9 and viral and non-viral vectors, as well as RNA-based interventions such as antisense oligonucleotides, siRNA, and mRNA therapeutics. Patent analysis underscores contributions from leading institutions, including the Children’s Medical Center Corp., BGI Shenzhen, and Sangamo Therapeutics, demonstrating translational potential and innovation in gene editing, delivery systems, and biomarker development. The convergence of precision diagnostics and patented molecular interventions presents a promising pathway toward curative treatment. While most approaches remain preclinical, progress in delivery technologies, ethical frameworks, and orphan disease regulatory incentives strengthens the translational pipeline. Collaborative, patent-driven innovation between academia and industry will be critical for translating these molecular insights into viable therapies for this rare disorder.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了Sanjad-Sakati综合征（SSS）的遗传机制、临床表现及新兴治疗策略，重点分析了基因编辑技术（如CRISPR-Cas9）、病毒/非病毒载体以及RNA干预疗法在治疗这种罕见疾病中的应用前景。
AI.research_question: 如何通过基因治疗和分子干预策略开发Sanjad-Sakati综合征的治愈性疗法？
AI.motivation: SSS目前主要依赖支持性治疗，缺乏根治方法，迫切需要开发创新性治疗策略来满足未满足的医疗需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于TBCE基因突变导致SSS的遗传机制，结合基因编辑、RNA干预和精准医疗理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述和专利分析，评估基因治疗技术（CRISPR-Cas9、病毒/非病毒载体、反义寡核苷酸、siRNA、mRNA疗法）的应用潜力。
AI.findings: 基因编辑和RNA干预技术显示出治疗SSS的潜力，主要机构在基因编辑、递送系统和生物标志物开发方面取得创新进展，但大多数方法仍处于临床前阶段。

title: Green Last-Mile Delivery Solutions for Densely Populated Cities

detail.title: Green Last-Mile Delivery Solutions for Densely Populated Cities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, patients, or animals, and therefore did not require formal ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted as part of the MBA dissertation requirements at the University of Ulster. No external funding was received

detail.abstract: During the actual days, companies face many challenges to get cost efficiency on the last mile and reduce the pollution, in view that last mile accounts for a significant part of light commercial vans in the city centres. However, governments are fighting to reduce the Co2 emission in the inner areas, creating barriers to companies such as reducing parking bay, reducing lanes for vehicles, not allowing vehicles to access roads in the city centre, increasing the number of bicycle lanes and creating more pedestrian zones. Not limited to the mentioned points, cities like London have created ultra-low emission zones where vehicles need to meet specific criteria not to pay a daily charge, but mostly all LCVs models need to pay, increasing the cost of the last-mile solution. Today, many solutions allow last-mile delivery to happen in the city centres using one foot, electric vehicles (Vans, cars, motorcycle or scooters) and cargo bikers. Companies need to be innovative and create strategies to keep delivery with the best cost efficiency in city centres.

AI.tldr: 城市中心最后一英里配送面临成本效率和污染控制的双重挑战，政府通过限制车辆通行、设立低排放区等措施增加配送成本，企业需要创新策略来维持成本效益。
AI.research_question: 如何在城市中心最后一英里配送中平衡成本效率和环境可持续性？
AI.motivation: 最后一英里配送占城市中心轻型商用车排放的很大部分，政府的环境政策增加了配送成本，企业需要寻找创新解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续物流理论、城市配送优化理论、环境政策影响分析
AI.method: 文献综述和案例分析，分析不同城市政策对最后一英里配送的影响
AI.findings: 政府的环境政策（如低排放区、停车位减少）显著增加了最后一英里配送成本，企业需要采用电动车辆、货运自行车等创新解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了城市中心最后一英里配送在环境政策约束下的成本效益平衡框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了在环境政策限制下优化最后一英里配送成本的具体策略建议

title: An Economic Analysis of Electricity Consumption and Electric Vehicle Adoption in California from 2010 to 2021
affiliations: University of New Mexico

detail.title: An Economic Analysis of Electricity Consumption and Electric Vehicle Adoption in California from 2010 to 2021
detail.abstract: This paper examines the influence of electric vehicles (EVs) on total annual electricity consumption across fifty-eight counties in California from 2010 to 2021. Using a log-linear model to analyze the relationship between electricity consumption and EV ownership, alongside a linearlog model with an instrumental variable (IV) approach, the study finds that annual per capita electricity consumption increased by 0.23% for each additional electric vehicle per 10,000 residents over the twelve-year period. The analysis identifies partisanship-measured as the annual percentage of voter registration for the Democratic Party by county-as a robust instrumental variable. Specifically, a 1% increase in Democratic voter registration corresponds to the adoption of approximately two additional EVs per 10,000 population.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2010-2021年加州58个县电动汽车对年用电量的影响，发现每增加1辆电动汽车/万居民，人均年用电量增加0.23%，并使用民主党选民注册比例作为工具变量。
AI.research_question: 电动汽车如何影响加州各县的年用电量？
AI.motivation: 随着电动汽车普及，了解其对电力需求的影响对电网规划和能源政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源消费理论和交通电气化理论，分析电动汽车对电力系统的影响。
AI.method: 使用对数线性模型分析用电量与电动汽车拥有量的关系，并采用线性对数模型配合工具变量方法。
AI.findings: 每增加1辆电动汽车/万居民，人均年用电量增加0.23%；民主党选民注册比例每增加1%，对应增加约2辆电动汽车/万人口。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了电动汽车与用电量之间的定量关系，为交通电气化对能源系统影响提供实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力公司负荷预测、电网规划和政府能源政策制定提供数据支持。

title: Pricing and Hedging Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefits (GMWBs) under a General Lévy Framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Pricing and Hedging Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefits (GMWBs) under a General Lévy Framework
detail.abstract:
Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefits (GMWBs) are embedded in variable annuity contracts to provide policyholders with a stable stream of retirement income while protecting against downside market risk. However, these guarantees pose significant pricing and hedging challenges for insurers. Traditional approaches based on the Black–Scholes framework often fail to capture the heavy-tailed distributions and sudden jumps observed in financial markets, leading to underestimation of risk.

This paper develops a valuation and hedging framework for GMWBs under general Lévy processes, which incorporate both continuous fluctuations and discontinuous jumps in asset dynamics. The wealth process is modeled through a Lévy-driven stochastic differential equation, and the associated contract value is characterized by a Partial Integro-Differential Equation (PIDE). Solutions are obtained using Monte Carlo simulations, finite difference techniques, and variance reduction methods.

Application of the model to different market regimes, withdrawal rates, and contract maturities demonstrates that Lévy-based pricing consistently produces higher fair fees than classical diffusion models, especially in volatile or jump-heavy markets. Hedging analysis further highlights the limitations of dynamic replication, as residual risks remain due to market incompleteness. Stress tests confirm the robustness of the Lévy framework under extreme conditions, offering practical insights for insurers and regulators.

The study contributes both theoretically and practically by extending the use of Lévy processes to retirement guarantees and providing insurers with more realistic tools for pricing and risk management. It also emphasizes the importance of robust modeling in ensuring the sustainability of retirement products in uncertain market environments.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于Lévy过程的GMWB定价和对冲框架，相比传统Black-Scholes模型能更准确捕捉市场中的厚尾分布和跳跃风险，为保险公司提供更现实的风险管理工具。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑市场跳跃和厚尾分布的情况下，为GMWB产品开发更准确的定价和对冲框架？
AI.motivation: 传统Black-Scholes框架无法充分捕捉金融市场中的重尾分布和突然跳跃，导致风险低估，这对保险公司管理GMWB产品风险构成挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lévy过程理论，包含连续波动和间断跳跃的资产动态建模；偏积分微分方程(PIDE)用于描述合约价值。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟、有限差分技术和方差缩减方法求解Lévy驱动的随机微分方程和PIDE。
AI.findings: Lévy定价模型在波动或跳跃频繁的市场中产生比传统扩散模型更高的公平费用；动态对冲存在剩余风险；压力测试证实Lévy框架在极端条件下的稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Lévy过程理论扩展到退休保障产品定价领域，为不完全市场下的金融衍生品定价提供理论扩展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司提供更现实的GMWB定价和风险管理工具，强调稳健建模对退休产品可持续性的重要性，为监管机构提供实践参考。

title: When Coping Means Breaking the Rules: Understanding Conservation Crime Through Strain
affiliations: University of Maryland, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Maryland - Department of Geographical Sciences

detail.title: When Coping Means Breaking the Rules: Understanding Conservation Crime Through Strain
detail.abstract: Conservation crime, including outlawed hunting, logging, and natural resource use, poses a direct threat to biodiversity worldwide. Reducing this harmful behavior and understanding the motivations of offenders is crucial, yet drivers remain underexamined. This study applies General Strain Theory to explore how social and environmental strains shape coping strategies, including conservation crime, among communities in and around Pù Mát National Park, Vietnam, a hotspot for conservation crime.  We conducted three phases of qualitative fieldwork in 2023 and 2024 across 16 communities, using semi-structured interviews, focus groups, and member-checking workshops with 218 participants.We identified nine distinct strains, ranging from unmet basic needs and economic hardship to land accessibility, environmental stressors and insufficient medical care. Four of them are novel, ecologically embedded forms, such as road and remoteness strain, or environmental stressors. Participants described four main coping strategies: conservation crime, outmigration, reliance on aid, and lifestyle adaptation. While participants did not always explicitly connect specific strains to illegal behavior, basic needs, economic, land and road and remoteness strains emerged as particularly salient and were most frequently discussed in relation to conservation crime. These findings suggest that broader structural inequalities—such as poverty, limited access to services, and spatial marginalization—may influence vulnerability to illegal resource use and merit attention as potentially criminogenic stressors. By applying General Strain Theory to conservation and extending it with ecologically grounded and spatially situated drivers of strain, this study offers a new lens for identifying, anticipating, and potentially addressing risks of conservation crime in protected areas.

AI.tldr: 本研究应用一般应变理论探讨越南Pù Mát国家公园周边社区的社会环境压力如何影响应对策略，包括保护犯罪。研究发现九种压力类型和四种主要应对策略，其中基本需求、经济、土地及道路偏远压力与保护犯罪关联最密切。
AI.research_question: 社会和环境压力如何塑造社区应对策略，包括保护犯罪？
AI.motivation: 保护犯罪对全球生物多样性构成直接威胁，但犯罪动机驱动因素研究不足，需要理解违法者的动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般应变理论，并扩展了生态基础和空间定位的压力驱动因素。
AI.method: 2023-2024年在16个社区进行三轮定性实地调查，使用半结构化访谈、焦点小组和成员检查工作坊，共218名参与者。
AI.findings: 识别出九种压力类型（四种为新型生态嵌入形式）和四种主要应对策略；基本需求、经济、土地及道路偏远压力与保护犯罪关联最密切。
AI.theory_contributions: 将一般应变理论应用于保护领域，扩展了生态基础和空间定位的压力驱动因素，为识别和预测保护犯罪风险提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示结构性不平等（如贫困、服务获取有限和空间边缘化）可能影响非法资源使用的脆弱性，为保护区域管理提供实践指导。

title: Inflation and Monetary Policy in Medium-sized New Keynesian DSGE Models
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), Ghent University - Department of General Economics, European Central Bank (ECB) and National Bank of Belgium

detail.title: Inflation and Monetary Policy in Medium-sized New Keynesian DSGE Models

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This chapter of the Research Handbook of Inflation (2025) reviews the evolution and current relevance of medium-scale New Keynesian Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium (DSGE) models, which serve as part of the core analytical framework in central banks and academic macroeconomics. The chapter assesses their capacity to analyse inflation dynamics, monetary transmission mechanisms, and policy interventions. Despite their exclusion of crisis-specific features, canonical models such as Smets and Wouters (2007) continue to explain inflation and output dynamics in the euro area and the US, owing in part to the differentiated effects of cost-push and demand shocks and the mitigating role of monetary policy. The chapter traces advancements in the European Central Bank’s New Area-Wide Model (NAWM), highlighting extensions that incorporate financial frictions, effective lower bounds, and energy price shocks. These enhancements have strengthened the model’s forecasting performance and interpretative power, especially during periods of unconventional monetary policy and energy-driven inflation. DSGE models are shown to be particularly effective for policy counterfactuals, enabling real-time assessments of policy decisions relative to model-based optimal policy. A robustness analysis under alternative scenarios demonstrates how policy rules can be evaluated through a welfare lens, informing the design of resilient monetary frameworks. Finally, the chapter identifies key modelling challenges exposed by recent inflation episodes and advocates for richer supply-side structures and nonlinear dynamics to improve the models’ capacity to capture complex macroeconomic developments.

AI.tldr: 本章回顾了中等规模新凯恩斯DSGE模型在通胀分析和货币政策评估中的演变与当前价值，评估了这些模型在解释通胀动态、政策传导机制方面的能力，并探讨了金融摩擦、有效下限约束等扩展如何增强模型预测性能。
AI.research_question: 中等规模新凯恩斯DSGE模型在分析通胀动态、货币政策传导机制和政策干预方面的能力如何？这些模型在当前宏观经济环境中的相关性如何？
AI.motivation: DSGE模型作为中央银行和学术宏观经济学的核心分析框架，需要评估其在解释通胀动态和政策评估方面的持续相关性，特别是在经历了金融危机和能源价格冲击等重大经济事件后。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，特别是Smets和Wouters（2007）的经典模型，以及欧洲央行新区域范围模型（NAWM）的扩展版本，包含金融摩擦、有效下限约束和能源价格冲击等要素。
AI.method: 文献综述和模型评估方法，包括对现有DSGE模型的理论基础和实证表现的回顾，以及通过政策反事实分析和稳健性检验来评估模型性能。
AI.findings: 经典DSGE模型仍能解释欧元区和美国的通胀和产出动态，归因于成本推动和需求冲击的差异化效应以及货币政策的缓解作用。扩展模型在非常规货币政策和能源驱动通胀时期表现出更强的预测能力和解释力。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了DSGE模型在政策反事实分析中的有效性，能够进行实时政策决策评估，并通过福利视角评估政策规则，为弹性货币政策框架设计提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行提供了改进的模型工具，增强了在复杂经济环境下的预测能力和政策评估能力，特别是在处理金融摩擦、有效下限约束和能源价格冲击等现实挑战时。

title: Cambodia and the United States Tariff: Modeling the Economic Impacts with GTAP-FIN
affiliations: Victoria University, Centre of Policy Studies and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Cambodia and the United States Tariff: Modeling the Economic Impacts with GTAP-FIN

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 810
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the potential economic impacts of the new United States (US) tariff on Cambodia using a dynamic global general equilibrium model (GTAP-FIN). We simulate the impact of US tariff increases announced in August 2025 while also examining two additional hypothetical cases for Cambodia. Hence, we investigate three scenarios: (i) the headline “reciprocal” tariff rate (19%) as announced on 31 July 2025; (ii) a hypothetical case, in which Cambodian products are only subject to the base tariff rate (10%); and (iii) a hypothetical case, in which Cambodian products are subject to a 36% tariff (the threatened rate leading up to 31 July 2025). US real output falls, driven by short run job losses, long run capital stock contractions, and losses in allocative efficiency. The impacts on Cambodia’s economy are close to zero at the 19% tariff level, positive at the 10% rate and negative at the 36% rate. Globally, regions most exposed to US tariffs see the largest impacts on real gross domestic product (GDP) and consumption. The analysis does not capture the potential adverse effects of heightened global trade policy uncertainty, suggesting that economic impacts on Cambodia may exceed those estimated in this report.

AI.tldr: 使用GTAP-FIN模型分析美国对柬埔寨新关税的经济影响，发现19%关税对柬埔寨影响接近零，10%关税有正面影响，36%关税有负面影响。美国自身经济会因就业损失、资本收缩和效率损失而受损。
AI.research_question: 美国对柬埔寨新关税的经济影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 分析2025年8月美国宣布对柬埔寨加征关税的潜在经济后果，为政策制定提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态全球一般均衡模型（GTAP-FIN）
AI.method: 模拟三种关税情景：19%实际税率、10%基础税率、36%威胁税率
AI.findings: 19%关税对柬埔寨经济影响接近零，10%关税有正面影响，36%关税有负面影响；美国经济会受损；全球受影响最大的是与美国贸易密切的地区
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了关税政策在一般均衡框架下的分析，提供了多情景比较的研究方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为柬埔寨和美国政策制定者提供关税影响评估，揭示不同税率水平的经济后果

title: How Family Undermines Accountability: Evidence from Italy
affiliations: and New York University (NYU) - Department of Politics

detail.title: How Family Undermines Accountability: Evidence from Italy
detail.abstract: The concept of electoral accountability is foundational to democratic systems. But can family ties undermine this core mechanism? While previous research has shown how factors like electoral competition, polarization, and access to information shape accountability, it has often overlooked the impact of politicians' connections and familial ties. We argue that politicians embedded in large family networks benefit from unconditional electoral support from their relatives, reducing their incentive to perform well in office. Employing a two-way fixed effects model and a regression discontinuity design in Italian municipal elections from 2000 to 2020, we find that having a mayor from a large family leads to poorer economic performance; nonetheless, despite this underperformance, such mayors do not face negative electoral consequences. These findings reveal how family ties can alter politicians' incentives to perform and undermine accountability in democratic systems.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，来自大家族的市长会导致更差的经济表现，但这些市长并不会因此面临选举惩罚，揭示了家族关系如何改变政治家的激励并削弱民主问责机制。
AI.research_question: 家族关系是否会削弱选举问责机制？
AI.motivation: 选举问责是民主制度的核心机制，但现有研究往往忽视政治家的人际关系和家族纽带对其行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选举问责理论、家族网络理论、政治激励理论
AI.method: 使用双向固定效应模型和断点回归设计，分析2000-2020年意大利市政选举数据
AI.findings: 来自大家族的市长导致更差的经济表现，但不会因此面临选举惩罚
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了家族网络如何通过提供无条件选举支持来改变政治家的绩效激励，拓展了选举问责理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解民主制度中问责机制的局限性提供了实证依据，对选举制度和反腐败政策具有启示意义

title: The Evolution of Decentralisation Policy in African Developing Countries
affiliations: Durban University of Technology, Durban University of Technology, University of South Africa (UNISA) and University of South Africa (UNISA)

detail.title: The Evolution of Decentralisation Policy in African Developing Countries
detail.abstract: The evolution of decentralization policy in African developing countries reflects a complex interplay of historical, political, and socio-economic factors. This paper examines the trajectory of decentralization from its colonial roots to contemporary practices, highlighting key milestones and trends. Initially introduced as a means of governance during colonial rule, decentralization has evolved into a strategy aimed at enhancing local autonomy, improving service delivery, and fostering democratic participation. The paper categorizes the various models of decentralization, administrative, fiscal, and political, and analyses their implementation across different countries. Furthermore, it explores the challenges faced, including issues of capacity, local governance, and socio-economic disparities. By evaluating twenty-one cases from 2012 – 2025 qualitatively, from diverse African contexts, the paper underscores the impact of decentralization on local development outcomes and citizen engagement. Ultimately, this study contributes to a deeper understanding of how decentralization policies may be effectively designed and implemented to promote sustainable development and democratic governance in African nations

AI.tldr: 本文分析了非洲发展中国家分权政策的演变历程，从殖民时期到当代实践，涵盖行政、财政和政治三种分权模式，通过21个案例研究探讨了分权对地方发展和公民参与的影响。
AI.research_question: 非洲发展中国家的分权政策如何演变？分权政策如何影响地方发展成果和公民参与？
AI.motivation: 理解非洲分权政策的复杂演变过程，探索如何有效设计和实施分权政策以促进可持续发展和民主治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分权理论框架，包括行政分权、财政分权和政治分权三种模式。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，分析2012-2025年间21个非洲国家的案例。
AI.findings: 分权政策从殖民时期的治理工具演变为增强地方自治、改善服务提供和促进民主参与的策略；面临能力建设、地方治理和社会经济差距等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对非洲分权政策演变的理解，丰富了分权理论在发展中国家背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家设计和实施有效的分权政策提供实践指导，促进可持续发展和民主治理。

detail.title: New Demand Economics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: On behalf of all authors, the corresponding author Fenghua Wen states that there is no conflict of interest. The authors declare that they have no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 72131011).

detail.abstract: We develop a theory of demand economics for an era of material abundance. The binding constraint on growth has shifted from insufficient aggregate demand to inadequate demand-tier upgrading. Our result is that, the new engine of growth lies in upgrading the demand hierarchy: higher-tier demands generate larger value-creation multipliers. The key mechanism is education-driven utility management. Education transforms the social utility function, raises the utility of higher-tier goods, and directs resources toward higher-value domains; this warrants a policy reorientation away from short-run aggregate stimulus toward education-centered, long-horizon investments in human capital. Methodologically, we build an estimable general-equilibrium framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个关于物质丰裕时代需求经济学的理论，认为经济增长的约束已从总需求不足转向需求层级升级不足。核心观点是：需求层级升级成为新增长引擎，高层次需求产生更大的价值创造乘数。关键机制是教育驱动的效用管理，教育通过改变社会效用函数，提高高层次商品的效用，引导资源流向高价值领域。这要求政策从短期总需求刺激转向以教育为中心的人力资本长期投资。
AI.research_question: 在物质丰裕时代，经济增长的新引擎是什么？如何通过需求层级升级推动经济增长？
AI.motivation: 传统经济增长理论主要关注总需求不足问题，但在物质丰裕时代，这一约束已发生变化。需要重新思考经济增长的驱动力，特别是需求结构升级对经济增长的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求经济学理论、需求层级理论、教育驱动的效用管理理论、一般均衡框架
AI.method: 构建可估计的一般均衡框架
AI.findings: 高层次需求产生更大的价值创造乘数；教育通过改变社会效用函数，提高高层次商品的效用，引导资源流向高价值领域
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了物质丰裕时代的需求经济学理论，构建了需求层级升级作为新增长引擎的理论框架，发展了教育驱动的效用管理机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供了新的方向：从短期总需求刺激转向以教育为中心的人力资本长期投资，强调需求层级升级对经济增长的重要性

title: Resolving the Contested Future of the GSEs: The Stakes are High
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Wharton School, Department of Real Estate  and Independent

detail.title: Resolving the Contested Future of the GSEs: The Stakes are High
detail.abstract: Seventeen years after Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac entered federal conservatorship, their future remains unresolved. This paper evaluates the economic, regulatory, and policy conditions under which the Government Sponsored Enterprises (GSEs) can responsibly exit conservatorship while maintaining their dual mission of promoting housing affordability and financial stability. Drawing on recent literature and new data, we assess whether the federal government has been repaid for its $191 billion intervention, examine the GSEs’ progress toward meeting Enterprise Regulatory Capital Framework requirements, and analyze the implications of privatization for mortgage rates, taxpayer risk, and affordable housing finance. The paper finds that the GSEs have effectively repaid the Treasury on a risk-adjusted basis and are on track to meet leverage capital standards by 2027. The authors propose a regulatory “public utility” framework that preserves liquidity in the mortgage-backed securities (MBS) market, stabilizes guarantee fee pricing, and supports affordable housing contributions through the Housing Trust Fund. The analysis shows that, under this model, privatization could occur without materially raising mortgage costs to first-time homebuyers. The paper concludes that a carefully structured exit—anchored by continued FHFA oversight, a paid-for federal commitment fee, and targeted reinvestment of Treasury warrant proceeds—offers a viable path to resolving the contested future of the GSEs.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了房利美和房地美退出联邦监管的经济条件，提出通过公共事业监管框架实现私有化，既能维持抵押贷款市场流动性，又不会显著提高首次购房者的抵押贷款成本。
AI.research_question: 在什么经济、监管和政策条件下，政府支持企业（GSEs）能够负责任地退出监管，同时保持其促进住房可负担性和金融稳定的双重使命？
AI.motivation: 房利美和房地美进入联邦监管已17年，其未来仍未解决，需要评估退出监管的可行路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共事业监管框架、风险调整回报分析、企业监管资本框架
AI.method: 基于近期文献和新数据的分析，评估政府干预的回报情况、资本标准达标进度、私有化对抵押贷款利率的影响
AI.findings: GSEs已在风险调整基础上有效偿还了财政部1910亿美元干预资金；预计到2027年将达到杠杆资本标准；在公共事业监管模式下私有化不会显著提高首次购房者的抵押贷款成本
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合公共事业监管和私有化的混合模式，为政府支持企业的未来治理提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的退出路径：持续FHFA监管、付费联邦承诺费、定向再投资财政部认股权证收益

title: The UNESCO Effect on Property Values: A Synthetic Control Study on the Dolomites
affiliations: University of Bologna - Department of Economics and University of Bologna - Department of Economics

detail.title: The UNESCO Effect on Property Values: A Synthetic Control Study on the Dolomites
detail.abstract: This paper estimates the causal impact of UNESCO World Heritage Site (WHS) designation on residential and commercial property values by focusing on the 2009 inscription of the Dolomites as a natural heritage site. By leveraging the unique structure of this trans-regional WHS-which spans multiple municipalities across three regions in Northern Italy-we conduct a fine-grained panel analysis on around 60 municipalities over 35 consecutive semester periods (from the second semester of 2005 to the second semester of 2022). To identify the "UNESCO effect," we implement a Synthetic Control Method design separately for three property typesordinary dwellings, luxury dwellings, and commercial units-setting up a donor pool of similar Alpine and pre-Alpine municipalities not affected by the WHS designation. Our results show that the 2009 UNESCO inscription led to a statistically significant and persistent increase in residential property values: effects for ordinary and luxury dwellings emerge within four years of inscription (from 2013) and peak at approximately C330 per square meter after approx. ten years; this effect remains significant through more than a decade after the inscription. By contrast, we find no significant impact on commercial property prices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究2009年多洛米蒂山被列为联合国教科文组织世界遗产对房产价值的影响，发现该称号显著提升了住宅物业价值，但对商业物业无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产称号对住宅和商业地产价值有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 探究世界遗产称号对当地房地产市场的影响，为政策制定和遗产管理提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于遗产经济学和房地产价值理论，分析文化遗产称号的外部性效应。
AI.method: 采用合成控制法，对意大利北部60个城市35个学期的面板数据进行分析，比较受影响的阿尔卑斯和亚阿尔卑斯城市。
AI.findings: 世界遗产称号导致住宅物业价值显著持续增长，普通和豪华住宅在入选后4年内开始显现效果，峰值约每平方米330欧元，效果持续超过十年；商业物业价格无显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为文化遗产称号对房地产市场的外部性效应提供了因果证据，丰富了遗产经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府制定遗产管理政策、房地产市场监管提供参考，帮助平衡遗产保护与经济发展。
