title: How Speech-Based Immigration Restrictions Threaten Academic Freedom
affiliations: George Mason University - Antonin Scalia Law School

detail.title: How Speech-Based Immigration Restrictions Threaten Academic Freedom

publicationDetails.detailsText: In ACADEMIC FREEDOM IN THE ERA OF TRUMP, Lee Bollinger and Geoffrey Stone, eds. (Oxford University Press, forthcoming)
George Mason Legal Studies Research Paper No. LS 25-18
publicationDetails.journalName: Antonin Scalia Law School, George Mason University Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Since he returned to office in January 2025, President Donald Trump’s administration has engaged in a systematic effort to deport non-citizen university students and academics who express views inimical to those of the US government on a number of issues. Litigation over these attempted deportations has focused on First Amendment free speech issues.  But speech-based deportations of students and academic university employees also threaten academic freedom. This chapter explains how and why.

Part I briefly summarizes the Trump Administration’s campaign of speech-based deportation of non-citizen students and academics. That campaign focuses primarily on students with anti-Israel and pro-Palestinian views regarding the ongoing war in Gaza. But its logic could just as easily justify targeting a wide range of other viewpoints. 

Part II presents an overview of the idea of academic freedom. That principle is related to, but distinct from freedom of speech. In some respects, it is narrower than the latter. But academic freedom does nonetheless require faculty and researchers to be able to consider and express a wide range of viewpoints on the issues they work on, and to be free of sanctions for viewpoints they express outside of the context of their academic work.  The same goes for students. Part III explains how speech-based deportations undermine the academic freedom of both non-citizens subject to deportation, and US-citizen scholars and students. The former effect is obvious. The latter is more indirect, but nonetheless large. Speech-based deportations of foreign students and academics chills the speech of their US-citizen colleagues and also deprives the latter of the opportunity for valuable interactions that could enhance their research, teaching, and learning. What is true of speech-based deportations is also true of speech-based exclusions of potential migrants even before they are allowed to set foot in the United States. 

Finally, Part IV considers multiple possible rationales for speech-based deportations and exclusions. Ironically, some of these rationales—currently advanced by a right-wing administration—turn out to be similar to traditional left-wing rationales for restrictions on “hate speech.” Whether deployed by the right or the left, the rationales are badly flawed. If correct, they cannot logically be limited to suppressing speech by non-citizens. Bigoted or otherwise reprehensible speech by US citizens creates comparable or greater dangers.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了特朗普政府基于言论立场驱逐非公民学生和学者的政策，探讨了这种政策如何威胁学术自由，并比较了左右翼限制言论的相似逻辑。
AI.research_question: 基于言论立场驱逐非公民学生和学者如何威胁学术自由？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府针对持有反以色列和亲巴勒斯坦观点的非公民学生和学者进行系统性驱逐，这种基于言论的驱逐政策不仅涉及第一修正案言论自由问题，更威胁到学术自由原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学术自由理论、言论自由理论、移民政策理论
AI.method: 理论分析、政策分析、案例研究
AI.findings: 基于言论的驱逐政策不仅直接影响被驱逐的非公民学者和学生，还间接影响美国公民学者的学术自由，造成言论寒蝉效应并剥夺学术交流机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了学术自由与言论自由的区别与联系，分析了基于言论的移民政策对学术自由的系统性威胁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、大学管理者和法律从业者提供了关于保护学术自由免受移民政策侵蚀的实践指导。

title: A Hamiltonian Phase-Space Approach to Foreign Exchange: Physics-Based Predictive Distributions without Curve Fitting

detail.title: A Hamiltonian Phase-Space Approach to Foreign Exchange: Physics-Based Predictive Distributions without Curve Fitting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No competing interests
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding

detail.abstract: We introduce a novel Hamiltonian framework for short-horizon foreign exchange (FX) dynamics that treats statistical moments as position coordinates in a low-dimensional phase space. The system evolves via physically motivated energy terms rather than curve fitting: potential energy encodes mean-reversion through Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) springs with optional cross-couplings, while triangular no-arbitrage constraints act as energy conservation laws. After standardizing to empirical-σ units, we employ Riemannian Manifold Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (RMHMC) to generate predictive distributions and make decisions at the distribution level using CDF-difference statistics and cost-exceedance gating. This approach preserves a "physics-first" philosophy, avoids traditional curve fitting, and explicitly accounts for trading frictions. We demonstrate the theoretical foundations and present the mathematical framework, establishing a new paradigm that bridges statistical mechanics and quantitative finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的哈密顿框架，将外汇动态的统计矩作为低维相空间中的位置坐标，通过物理启发的能量项而非曲线拟合来建模系统演化。该方法结合了均值回归、无套利约束和交易摩擦，使用Riemannian流形哈密顿蒙特卡洛生成预测分布。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个基于物理原理的哈密顿框架来建模短期外汇动态，避免传统曲线拟合方法？
AI.motivation: 传统外汇建模方法依赖曲线拟合，缺乏物理基础，无法有效处理交易摩擦和无套利约束。需要一种基于物理原理的新范式来桥接统计力学和量化金融。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈密顿力学框架，将统计矩作为相空间坐标；Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程建模均值回归；无套利三角约束作为能量守恒定律；Riemannian流形几何。
AI.method: 使用Riemannian流形哈密顿蒙特卡洛(RMHMC)生成预测分布；通过CDF差异统计和成本超限门控进行分布级决策；标准化到经验σ单位。
AI.findings: 提出的哈密顿框架能够有效建模外汇动态，生成可靠的预测分布，同时显式处理交易摩擦和无套利约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了统计力学与量化金融之间的新桥梁；提出了将统计矩作为相空间坐标的哈密顿框架；发展了基于物理原理而非曲线拟合的外汇建模新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外汇交易提供了基于分布级决策的新方法；显式考虑了交易摩擦；通过RMHMC生成更可靠的预测分布；为风险管理提供了新工具。

title: Caring Connections in Italy: The Role of Immigrant Caregivers in Improving the Welfare of Elders and Reducing Public Health Costs
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata, Sapienza University of Rome - Dipartimento di Scienze Sociali ed Economich, University of Rome Tor Vergata and University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Caring Connections in Italy: The Role of Immigrant Caregivers in Improving the Welfare of Elders and Reducing Public Health Costs

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the impact of migrant-provided home-based care on elderly health in Italy, focusing on hospitalisation frequency, length of stay, and mortality. To address potential endogeneity between local health conditions and immigrant settlement , we use an instrumental variable approach. Our results show that an higer supply of migrant caregivers reduces both the frequency (extensive margin) and duration (intensive margin) of hospital admissions. One percentage point increase in the immigrant-to-elderly population ratio leads to a 4% decline in long-term and rehabilitation inpatient admissions, with no effect on acute inpatient. We also find a 1.5% reduction in average admission duration, rising to 3.3% for LRI cases. These effects are primarily driven by diagnoses related to traumatic injuries, musculoskeletal and genitourinary conditionsareas closely linked to home-based mobility and care management. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that the observed 1.3 percentage point average annual increase in the migrant-to-elderly ratio during our study period corresponds to an estimated 9% reduction in elderly LRI hospitalisation costs, yielding annual public savings of approximately 0.66% of total hospitalisation expenditures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了意大利移民提供的家庭护理对老年人健康的影响，发现移民护工供应增加能显著减少老年人住院频率和住院时长，特别是对于长期和康复住院，每年可为公共医疗系统节省约0.66%的住院费用。
AI.research_question: 移民提供的家庭护理如何影响意大利老年人的健康结果，特别是住院频率、住院时长和死亡率？
AI.motivation: 随着人口老龄化加剧，家庭护理需求日益增长，移民在提供家庭护理服务中扮演重要角色，但缺乏关于其对老年人健康影响的系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康经济学和移民劳动力市场理论，采用工具变量方法解决移民定居与当地健康状况之间的内生性问题。
AI.method: 使用工具变量方法，以移民与老年人人口比例作为关键变量，分析其对住院频率、住院时长和死亡率的影响。
AI.findings: 移民护工供应增加1个百分点，长期和康复住院减少4%，平均住院时长减少1.5%，对于长期和康复住院病例减少3.3%。这些效应主要出现在创伤、肌肉骨骼和泌尿系统疾病等与家庭护理管理密切相关的领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了移民家庭护理对老年人健康的经济价值，为健康经济学和移民劳动力市场研究提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究显示移民护工供应增加每年可为公共医疗系统节省约0.66%的住院费用，为政策制定者优化医疗资源配置提供了重要参考。

title: Income Taxation Across Countries
affiliations: Arizona State University (ASU) and Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title: Income Taxation Across Countries

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines income tax systems in over thirty countries over the past forty years using microdata from the Luxembourg Income Study. We show that income tax systems worldwide are well approximated by a two-parameter log-linear effective tax function. We provide country- and year-specific estimates and document several insights. First, higher average tax rates are associated with higher progressivity. Second, richer countries have more progressive tax systems. Third, progressivity varies by family structure, with marriage and children associated with higher progressivity. Finally, transfers play an important role in redistribution, making the overall tax-and-transfer function more progressive than the tax function.

AI.tldr: 本文使用卢森堡收入研究的微观数据，分析了30多个国家过去40年的所得税制度。研究发现全球所得税制度可以用两参数对数线性有效税收函数很好地近似，并揭示了平均税率与累进性正相关、富裕国家税制更累进、家庭结构影响累进性以及转移支付增强整体累进性等重要发现。
AI.research_question: 全球所得税制度的特征和演变规律是什么？不同国家所得税制度的累进性如何？
AI.motivation: 理解全球范围内所得税制度的共同特征和差异，为税收政策设计提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两参数对数线性有效税收函数模型，用于近似描述所得税制度。
AI.method: 使用卢森堡收入研究的微观数据，对30多个国家过去40年的所得税制度进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1) 平均税率与累进性正相关；2) 富裕国家税制更累进；3) 婚姻和子女与更高累进性相关；4) 转移支付使整体税收转移函数比单纯税收函数更累进。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了描述全球所得税制度的统一理论框架，验证了税收累进性的跨国规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国税收政策设计提供了实证参考，揭示了转移支付在收入再分配中的重要作用。

title: Do Anti-Immigration Attitudes Discourage Immigration? Evidence from a New Instrument
affiliations: Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER), University of Luxemburg and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Do Anti-Immigration Attitudes Discourage Immigration? Evidence from a New Instrument

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We investigate the effect of anti-immigration attitudes on immigration plans to Europe. Wepropose a new instrument for attitudes toward immigration, namely, the number of country nationalskilled in terrorist attacks taking place outside of Europe. Our first-stage results confirmthat such terrorist attacks increase negative attitudes to immigration in the origin country of thevictims. Our second-stage results then show that this higher hostility toward migrants decreasesthe attractiveness of the country for prospective immigrants.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了反移民态度对欧洲移民计划的影响，提出使用本国公民在欧洲以外恐怖袭击中的死亡人数作为移民态度的工具变量，发现此类恐怖袭击会增加来源国对移民的负面态度，进而降低该国对潜在移民的吸引力。
AI.research_question: 反移民态度如何影响欧洲的移民计划？
AI.motivation: 理解移民态度对移民决策的影响机制，为移民政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于移民决策理论和态度-行为关系理论，探讨反移民态度如何影响移民目的地的选择。
AI.method: 使用工具变量方法，以本国公民在欧洲以外恐怖袭击中的死亡人数作为移民态度的工具变量，进行两阶段回归分析。
AI.findings: 恐怖袭击会增加来源国对移民的负面态度，这种更高的敌意会降低该国对潜在移民的吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的移民态度工具变量，丰富了移民决策理论中态度因素的研究方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解移民流动的影响因素提供了实证证据，有助于制定更有效的移民政策。

title: Public Gains, Private Strains: Public Investment and Private Schooling in Peru
affiliations: University of Sussex - Department of Economics, University of Sussex, Department of Economics, University of Sussex and

detail.title: Public Gains, Private Strains: Public Investment and Private Schooling in Peru

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: In the 2010s, Peru experienced an increase in public educational investment, a substantial improvement in public school learning outcomes, and an erosion in the private sector learning premium. We use longitudinal, geo-coded register data on primary schools and pupils in urban areas to study how the improvement in public schooling affected private schools. With a difference in differences (DiD) framework, we demonstrate that the increase in public school quality reduced enrolment and test scores in private schools, primarily in areas with lower education levels. A staggered DiD analysis shows that new public school openings also reduced enrolment in nearby private schools.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2010年代秘鲁公共教育质量提升对私立学校的影响，发现公立学校质量的提高导致私立学校入学率和考试成绩下降，特别是在教育水平较低的地区。
AI.research_question: 公立学校教育质量的提升如何影响私立学校的入学率和学生表现？
AI.motivation: 秘鲁在2010年代经历了公共教育投资增加、公立学校学习成果显著改善以及私立部门学习溢价下降的现象，需要研究这种变化对私立学校的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育市场竞争理论，分析公立教育质量提升对私立教育市场的冲击效应。
AI.method: 使用纵向地理编码登记数据，采用双重差分法(DiD)和交错双重差分法分析公立学校质量提升和新建公立学校对私立学校的影响。
AI.findings: 公立学校质量提升显著降低了私立学校的入学率和考试成绩，特别是在教育水平较低的地区；新建公立学校的开设也减少了附近私立学校的入学率。
AI.theory_contributions: 为教育市场竞争理论提供了实证证据，揭示了公立教育质量提升对私立教育市场的替代效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了关于公共教育投资对私立教育市场影响的实证依据，有助于优化教育资源配置。

title: "Big Picture" Predicts Destination Attractiveness: the Role of Physical Breadth and Contextual Breadth
affiliations: , Xidian University, Beijing Technology and Business University - Business School, Kyoto University, Tsinghua University, Tsinghua University, Kyoto University, Tsinghua University and Tsinghua University

detail.title: "Big Picture" Predicts Destination Attractiveness: the Role of Physical Breadth and Contextual Breadth
detail.abstract: In global tourism, renowned attractions with diverse visual styles consistently yield positive experiences. This study introduced the 'big picture' metaphor as a universal visual code underlying their appeal. Drawing on the broaden-and-build theory, we proposed a two-dimensional visual breadth (2DVB) model, identifying physical breadth (expansiveness of visual fields) and contextual breadth (variety of visual contexts) as key predictors of destination ratings. A deep neural network with advanced feature recognition was developed to operationalize this model. Analyzing 588,821 photos from 120 global destinations, our analyses showed that both the physical and contextual visual breadth positively predicted destination ratings, validating the model. This approach surpassed traditional content-based methods, offering a new framework for cross-scene analysis in tourism management, guiding strategic planning and promotion.

AI.tldr: 本研究引入'大画面'隐喻作为全球知名旅游景点吸引力的通用视觉编码，基于拓展-建构理论提出二维视觉广度模型，通过深度学习分析全球120个目的地的588,821张照片，验证了物理广度和情境广度对目的地评分的正向预测作用。
AI.research_question: 全球知名旅游景点的视觉吸引力是否可以通过物理广度和情境广度这两个维度来预测目的地评分？
AI.motivation: 全球旅游业中，具有多样化视觉风格的知名景点始终能带来积极体验，需要探索其背后的通用视觉编码机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拓展-建构理论，提出二维视觉广度模型（物理广度和情境广度）
AI.method: 开发基于深度神经网络的高级特征识别系统，分析120个全球目的地的588,821张照片
AI.findings: 物理视觉广度和情境视觉广度都正向预测目的地评分，验证了模型的有效性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了'大画面'隐喻作为通用视觉编码，建立了二维视觉广度模型，为跨场景分析提供了新框架
AI.practical_contributions: 超越了传统基于内容的方法，为旅游管理提供战略规划和推广指导

title: The Effects of Maternity Leave Benefits on Mothers and Children. A Reexamination
affiliations: , University of Oslo - Ragnar Frisch Centre for Economic Research and University of Oslo - Ragnar Frisch Centre for Economic Research

detail.title: The Effects of Maternity Leave Benefits on Mothers and Children. A Reexamination

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We provide a full reexamination of the effects of a maternity leave extension implemented in Norway in 1977. Previous research reporting large favorable long-term effects on mothers' health and on offspring's educational and labor market outcomes relied on an incorrect description of the reform and an invalid identification strategy. In the present paper, we show that the previously reported results are misleading. Building on an accurate description of the reform and its implementation, we document that it had no noticeable long-term effects on mothers' health or on offspring's education and labor market outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文重新检验了挪威1977年产假延长政策的影响，发现先前研究因对改革描述错误和识别策略无效而得出误导性结论。基于对改革的准确描述，本文证明该政策对母亲健康和子女教育及劳动力市场结果没有显著长期影响。
AI.research_question: 挪威1977年产假延长政策对母亲健康和子女教育及劳动力市场结果是否有长期影响？
AI.motivation: 先前研究因对改革描述错误和识别策略无效而得出误导性结论，需要重新检验产假延长政策的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策评估理论和因果推断方法，重新构建有效的识别策略。
AI.method: 基于对改革的准确描述和有效识别策略，重新分析政策影响。
AI.findings: 产假延长政策对母亲健康和子女教育及劳动力市场结果没有显著长期影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 纠正了先前研究的错误结论，为产假政策评估提供了更可靠的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于产假延长政策实际效果的准确信息，避免基于误导性研究制定政策。

title: The Effect of Wildfire on Violations of Regulatory Drinking Water Standards in the US
affiliations: USDA Forest Service, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Effect of Wildfire on Violations of Regulatory Drinking Water Standards in the US
detail.abstract: Wildfires pose a threat to drinking water supplies by altering watershed conditions and impairing treatment infrastructure. Using data on public water supply systems and historical wildfire boundaries from 2004–2023 across the US, we econometrically estimate the relationship between upstream burn area and downstream Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) violations and treatment costs. Results indicate that high-severity wildfire significantly increases both violations and costs, with effects persisting several years after a fire. In contrast, low-severity wildfire has no measurable effect. To quantify the consequences of rising wildfire risk, we simulate wildfire occurrence and land recovery using probabilistic risk data from the USDA Forest Service and apply elasticities from the econometric analysis to forecast changes in costs under two historical baselines. Holding other factors constant, the rise in wildfire risk from 2014 to 2020 alone increases expected medical and water treatment costs by $641 million annually.

AI.tldr: 本文通过计量经济学方法研究美国上游野火面积与下游饮用水安全违规及处理成本的关系，发现高强度野火显著增加违规率和成本，且影响持续数年，而低强度野火无显著影响。基于USDA森林服务局的风险数据模拟预测，2014-2020年野火风险上升使年度医疗和水处理成本增加6.41亿美元。
AI.research_question: 上游野火面积如何影响下游饮用水安全违规率和处理成本？
AI.motivation: 野火通过改变流域条件和损害处理设施威胁饮用水供应安全
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学和风险管理理论，分析野火对公共供水系统的外部性影响
AI.method: 使用2004-2023年美国公共供水系统和历史野火边界数据，进行计量经济学估计
AI.findings: 高强度野火显著增加SDWA违规率和处理成本，影响持续数年；低强度野火无显著影响
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了野火对饮用水安全的长期影响机制，拓展了环境风险外部性理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供野火风险管理依据，预测了野火风险上升带来的经济成本

title: Artificial Intelligence as Cognitive Infrastructure: Documenting the Role of AI in the Discovery of Black Belt OS™

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence as Cognitive Infrastructure: Documenting the Role of AI in the Discovery of Black Belt OS™
detail.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into scientific practice is rapidly reshaping the production of knowledge, raising questions of authorship, validity, and epistemic legitimacy. This article documents the role of AI in the discovery and articulation of the Black Belt OS (BB-OS), a proposed universal structural law of organization. While the foundational insight-the recognition of nine essential processes, forty-five steps, and ninety-eight irreducible actions-was provided by the human author, the large language model (LLM) functioned as a cognitive infrastructure: synthesizing literature, mapping analogies across domains, generating structured drafts, and testing falsifiability criteria. We detail the workflow, including prompt engineering, evidence validation, logging of outputs, and human oversight. The article demonstrates that AI did not originate the law but amplified its articulation, accelerating the 2 transition from intuitive insight to rigorous scientific documentation. The implications are threefold: (i) for epistemology, AI-assisted reasoning inaugurates a new model of scientific discovery; (ii) for research practice, we propose a reproducible protocol for integrating AI while preserving human authorship; (iii) for management and organizational science, the BB-OS becomes the first documented case of a structural law articulated through human-AI collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了AI在发现和阐述Black Belt OS（BB-OS）这一组织普遍结构定律中的作用。人类作者提供了核心洞察，而大型语言模型作为认知基础设施，协助文献综合、类比映射、结构化草稿生成和可证伪性测试。
AI.research_question: AI在科学发现中扮演什么角色？如何通过人机协作来阐述科学定律？
AI.motivation: AI正重塑科学实践，引发了关于作者身份、有效性和认识论合法性的问题。需要探索AI在科学发现中的具体作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI辅助推理模型、科学发现理论、人机协作框架
AI.method: 详细记录工作流程，包括提示工程、证据验证、输出记录和人工监督
AI.findings: AI没有原创定律，但放大了其阐述，加速了从直觉洞察到严谨科学文档的转变
AI.theory_contributions: 为认识论贡献了AI辅助推理的新科学发现模型；为研究实践提出了可复现的人机协作协议
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理和组织科学提供了首个通过人机协作阐述的结构定律案例；建立了可复现的AI集成工作流程

title: Enhancing the Self-Directed Learning of Non-Native English Speaking Employees Through an Integration of Peer Support and Digital Applications

detail.title: Enhancing the Self-Directed Learning of Non-Native English Speaking Employees Through an Integration of Peer Support and Digital Applications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable

detail.abstract: combination of globalization and growth of the immigrant population has created a need to foster more inclusive training. Currently, many organizations rely on traditional English-only training and have discriminatory practices which dampens the self-efficacy of non-native English speakers. Digital applications, ChatGPT and Google Translate, and peer support offer cost effective solutions to foster a sustainable training environment. A quasi-experimental study using four phases including baselining, the intervention of peer training, the intervention of self-directed learning, and evaluation was implemented in a real-world manufacturing environment.  A total of 28 non-native English speaking machine operator trainees completed  pre-intervention and post-intervention surveys that measured the self-efficacy to engage in self-directed learning. Results from paired samples t-tests indicated statistically significant increases in self-efficacy after the interventions across the entire group as well as all three sampled shifts. The findings indicate that the digital applications and peer support foster improved self-efficacy for non-native English speaking trainees to engage in self-directed learning behaviors. Consequently, this offers leaders of cash strapped organizations a training approach that is practical and affordable while aligning to philosophical trends. It also supports inclusive training of a growing portion of the population which can improve long-term sustainability. Potential limits to the study are in the form of its short-term nature which doesn’t account for the novelty effect, its small sample size, and the survey design does not measure real knowledge growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过数字应用(ChatGPT、谷歌翻译)和同伴支持干预，显著提高了非英语母语机器操作员学员的自我效能感，为资源有限的组织提供了实用且负担得起的包容性培训方案。
AI.research_question: 数字应用和同伴支持如何影响非英语母语学员在自我导向学习中的自我效能感？
AI.motivation: 全球化和移民人口增长需要更包容的培训，但当前许多组织依赖传统英语培训并存在歧视性做法，抑制了非英语母语者的自我效能感。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我效能理论、自我导向学习理论、包容性培训理论
AI.method: 准实验研究，采用四阶段设计：基线测量、同伴培训干预、自主学习干预、评估，在真实制造环境中对28名非英语母语机器操作员学员进行前后测调查
AI.findings: 配对样本t检验显示，干预后整个群体及所有三个轮班组的自我效能感均有统计学显著提升
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了数字应用和同伴支持在提升非英语母语学员自我效能感方面的有效性，丰富了包容性培训理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源有限的组织提供了经济实用的培训方法，支持对日益增长的移民人口的包容性培训，改善长期可持续性

title: Readers Prefer Outputs of AI Trained on Copyrighted Books over Expert Human Writers
affiliations: Stony Brook University, Columbia University - Law School and University of Michigan, Ann Arbor

detail.title: Readers Prefer Outputs of AI Trained on Copyrighted Books over Expert Human Writers

declarations.ethicsApproval: All procedures involving human participants were approved by the University of Michigan Institutional Review Board (HUM00264127). Informed consent was obtained from all participants, who were compensated for their time. The study was preregistered at OSF (https://osf.io/zt4ad).

publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The use of copyrighted books for training AI models has led to numerous lawsuits from authors concerned about AI's ability to generate derivative content. Yet it's unclear whether these models can generate high quality literary text while emulating authors' styles/voices. To answer this we conducted a preregistered study comparing MFA-trained expert writers with three frontier AI models: ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini in writing up to 450 word excerpts emulating 50 awardwinning authors' (including Nobel laureates, Booker Prize winners, and young emerging National Book Award finalists) diverse styles. In blind pairwise evaluations by 159 representative expert (MFA candidates from top U.S. writing programs) and lay readers (recruited via Prolific), AI-generated text from in-context prompting was strongly disfavored by experts for both stylistic fidelity (odds ratio [OR]=0.16, p < 10^-8) and writing quality (OR=0.13, p< 10^-7) but showed mixed results with lay readers. However, fine-tuning ChatGPT on individual author's complete works completely reversed these findings: experts now favored AI-generated text for stylistic fidelity (OR=8.16, p < 10^-13) and writing quality (OR=1.87, p=0.010), with lay readers showing similar shifts. These effects are robust under cluster-robust inference and generalize across authors and styles in author-level heterogeneity analyses. The fine-tuned outputs were rarely flagged as AI-generated (3% rate versus 97% for incontext prompting) by state-of-the-art AI detectors. Mediation analysis reveals this reversal occurs because fine-tuning eliminates detectable AI stylistic quirks (e.g., cliché density) that penalize incontext outputs, altering the relationship between AI detectability and reader preference. While we do not account for additional costs of human effort required to transform raw AI output into cohesive, publishable prose, the median fine-tuning and inference cost of $81 per author represents a dramatic 99.7% reduction compared to typical professional writer compensation. Author-specific fine-tuning thus enables non-verbatim AI writing that readers prefer to expert human writing, thereby providing empirical evidence directly relevant to copyright's fourth fair-use factor, the "effect upon the potential market or value" of the source works.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，通过微调AI模型可以生成比专业作家更受读者偏好的文学作品，这对版权法中的合理使用条款提出了挑战。
AI.research_question: AI模型能否生成高质量文学作品并模仿作者风格？
AI.motivation: AI使用受版权保护的书籍训练引发法律争议，但AI能否真正模仿作者风格生成高质量文学文本尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于版权法中的合理使用原则，特别是"对潜在市场或价值的影响"这一因素。
AI.method: 采用预注册研究设计，比较MFA专业作家与三种前沿AI模型（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini）在模仿50位获奖作家风格方面的表现，通过159名专家和普通读者的盲评进行评估。
AI.findings: 上下文提示生成的AI文本被专家强烈否定，但经过微调的AI文本在风格保真度和写作质量上均优于人类专家作品。
AI.theory_contributions: 为版权法中的合理使用条款提供了实证证据，证明微调AI可以生成读者偏好的非逐字复制作品。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了AI微调在文学创作中的巨大潜力，每位作者仅需81美元的成本，比专业作家报酬降低99.7%。

detail.abstract: Outsmart the Checkout is a practical, evidence-based guide to paying less without buying less. Drawing on price audits and store-shelf checks from ThePricer, it explains how modern checkout flows nudge higher spend—dynamic prices, timers, bundles, “drip” fees, and shrinkflation—and how to counter them with repeatable tactics. Readers learn to compare like-for-like via unit pricing, build an all-in cost (taxes, fees, shipping, returns), time purchases, and evaluate loyalty/coupons/subscriptions without the sunk-cost trap. Each chapter ends with short checklists and quick, reproducible math.

AI.tldr: 这是一本关于如何在购物时减少支出的实用指南，通过价格审计和货架检查揭示现代结账流程如何引导更高消费，并提供可重复的策略来应对动态定价、捆绑销售、隐形费用等问题。
AI.research_question: 现代结账流程如何影响消费者支出决策？消费者如何有效应对这些影响以减少购物支出？
AI.motivation: 现代零售环境中的结账流程设计往往通过心理策略引导消费者增加支出，消费者需要实用的方法来识别和应对这些策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、消费者心理学、定价策略理论
AI.method: 基于ThePricer的价格审计和商店货架检查，结合案例分析和实用策略开发
AI.findings: 现代结账流程使用动态定价、倒计时、捆绑销售、隐形费用和缩水式通胀等策略增加消费者支出；通过单位价格比较、全成本计算、时机选择和理性评估忠诚度计划等方法可以有效应对。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统分析了现代零售结账流程中的心理策略机制，为消费者行为研究提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的、可操作的购物策略和检查清单，帮助消费者在实际购物中减少支出而不减少购买量。

title: Logistical Competition and Risk in Wheat Trade and Impacts of Changes in Black Sea Shipping
affiliations: North Dakota State University

detail.title: Logistical Competition and Risk in Wheat Trade and Impacts of Changes in Black Sea Shipping
detail.abstract: Abstract:  The Russia-Ukraine war has drastically affected international grain marketing. Most important are 1) shipments through traditional Black Sea routes, which are now subject to capacity constraints, are riskier due to the war, and face higher ocean shipping costs partly as a result of the conflict; and 2) the development of new ports in the Baltic Sea. Additionally, the international marketing system has transitioned from a highly competitive spatial market to one that the Russian government controls more extensively. The Russian government has maintained  policies of export quotas and minimum export prices, while recently announcing the designation of ‘friendly’ countries, which are targeted for favorable trade terms. The purpose of this paper is to determine the potential impacts of changes in the export regime in the Black Sea region on logistical risk and international trade flows in wheat. The model was specified to determine the most efficient trade flows and routes between export ports and importing regions and countries.  The results have implications for logistical and infrastructure policy for shippers from the Black Sea origins as well as for competitors. Russia’s competitive advantage lies with Turkey and other Middle Eastern countries, as well as North Africa (including Egypt). Russia dominates the Middle East and competes with the United States in Mexico, while maintaining a presence in Southeast Asia.  Several sensitivities were evaluated to assess their impact on logistical functions.  Taken together, the results illustrate the logistics competition and impacts of policies on shipping infrastructure demands and quantify risks.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了俄乌战争对国际粮食市场的影响，特别是黑海地区出口制度变化对小麦贸易物流风险和贸易流量的潜在影响。研究发现俄罗斯在土耳其、中东国家和北非具有竞争优势，并与美国在墨西哥竞争。
AI.research_question: 黑海地区出口制度变化对物流风险和国际小麦贸易流量的潜在影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 俄乌战争显著影响了国际粮食市场，特别是黑海传统航线面临容量限制、战争风险和更高的海运成本，同时波罗的海新港口发展，俄罗斯政府加强了对市场的控制。

AI.method: 构建模型确定出口港口与进口区域和国家之间最有效的贸易流量和路线

title: International Finance and the Geopolitics of Market Infrastructures
affiliations: George Mason University, Antonin Scalia Law School

detail.title: International Finance and the Geopolitics of Market Infrastructures

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of International Economic Law, Vol. 25, Forthcoming 2025
George Mason Law & Economics Research Paper No. 25-13
publicationDetails.journalName: Antonin Scalia Law School, George Mason University, Law & Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This Article examines how financial market infrastructures (FMIs)—long regarded as neutral, technocratic utilities—have become instruments of geopolitical influence and economic statecraft. Drawing on three case studies—SWIFT sanctions, EU-UK post-Brexit equivalence disputes, and the EU’s withdrawal of FMI recognition for India, South Africa, and the United Arab Emirates—this article shows how FMIs are increasingly ‘weaponized’ as tools of financial diplomacy. It argues that mutual recognition and equivalence regimes, originally designed to foster cross-border regulatory coordination and financial stability, have evolved into levers of jurisdictional power. These mechanisms now serve both ‘offensive’ purposes (such as sanctions) and ‘defensive’ strategies (such as re-shoring euro clearing), revealing their political and discretionary nature. Yet, this transformation is not necessarily a design failure. Rather, it reflects the adaptability of these regimes to a pluralistic international legal order where sovereignty and market access must be balanced. The Article contributes to the literature on international financial governance by analyzing how FMI access decisions sit at the intersection of law, markets, and geopolitics—and by suggesting how these dynamics might reshape global financial integration.

AI.method: 案例研究法，分析SWIFT制裁、欧盟-英国脱欧后对等性争议、欧盟撤销对印度等国的FMI认可三个具体案例

title: From SEO to AIO: Agent Intent Optimization in the Age of Algorithmic Shoppers

detail.title: From SEO to AIO: Agent Intent Optimization in the Age of Algorithmic Shoppers
detail.abstract: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) has long defined how firms make products discoverable to human consumers. However, the emergence of AI agents that transact autonomously on behalf of consumers presents new challenges for digital marketing strategies. This paper introduces Agent Intent Optimization (AIO), a conceptual framework for optimizing product visibility and selection probability in AI-mediated commerce environments. We also introduce the term "Shopper Schism" to describe the fundamental separation between human intention and algorithmic execution that characterizes this new commercial landscape. Through synthesis of emerging industry evidence and established marketing theory, we propose that AIO represents a shift from psychological persuasion to logical optimization. Drawing on recent empirical research demonstrating distinct AI agent purchasing behaviors, we develop a five-component framework for AIO implementation and explore its managerial implications. While SEO targets human cognitive processes, AIO focuses on machine-interpretable signals, structured data, and algorithmic decision criteria. This conceptual framework contributes to understanding how digital marketing may evolve as AI agents become more prevalent in commercial transactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agent Intent Optimization (AIO)概念框架，用于优化AI代理商业环境中的产品可见性和选择概率，并引入"购物者分裂"概念描述人类意图与算法执行之间的分离。
AI.research_question: 在AI代理自主交易的商业环境中，如何优化产品可见性和选择概率？
AI.motivation: AI代理代表消费者自主交易的出现对数字营销策略提出了新挑战，传统的搜索引擎优化(SEO)主要针对人类消费者，无法有效应对AI代理的购买行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于新兴行业证据和既有营销理论的综合，提出从心理说服向逻辑优化的转变。
AI.method: 通过综合新兴行业证据和既有营销理论，结合最近实证研究中展示的AI代理购买行为，开发AIO实施框架。
AI.findings: AIO与SEO不同，它关注机器可解释信号、结构化数据和算法决策标准，而非人类认知过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AIO概念框架和"购物者分裂"概念，为理解AI代理在商业交易中日益普及时数字营销的演变提供了理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了包含五个组件的AIO实施框架，并探讨了其管理意义，为企业在新兴AI商业环境中优化产品可见性提供了实践指导。

title: Private Equity Diversity and Talent: Do they Matter for Acquisitive Growth?

detail.title: Private Equity Diversity and Talent: Do they Matter for Acquisitive Growth?

declarations.funderStatement: ESRC: Research Grant (ES/W010259/1): Understanding how constraints on access to finance and under-investment impact on productivity growth in smaller firms

detail.abstract: Building on the strategic entrepreneurship perspective and upper echelon theory, we examine the importance of private equity (PE) functional human capital and socio-demographic diversity for the success of the acquisitive growth strategy. Our focus is on the buyout lead partner team (LPT) rather than on human capital at the collective PE firm (or fund) level. The results of our panel data survival models suggest that gender and age diversity, as well as the financial background, significantly accelerate both first and subsequent add-on acquisitions. The results are robust to alternative proxies, model specifications and endogeneity checks.

title: Leadership as a Mediator Between Personality Traits (HEXACO) and CEO-driven Innovation: A Study with Mediation Modelling
affiliations: Universidad de Córdoba, Universidad de la Costa and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Leadership as a Mediator Between Personality Traits (HEXACO) and CEO-driven Innovation: A Study with Mediation Modelling
detail.abstract: The relationship between CEO personality traits and organizational innovation has been widely proposed, yet the mechanisms linking these constructs remain unclear. This study examines whether leadership mediates the relationship between CEO personality traits—based on the HEXACO model—and innovation outcomes. Using survey data from 106 CEOs of micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in an emerging economy, we conducted an exploratory factor analysis that identified five empirical dimensions of personality: integrity–responsibility, organized openness, emotional–ethical self-control, social discipline, and cooperation–interpersonal honesty. Regression analyses showed that organized openness and social discipline significantly predicted innovation (R² = 0.31), while integrity–responsibility, organized openness, and social discipline predicted leadership (R² = 0.53). A mediation model demonstrated excellent fit (CFI = 1.00; TLI = 1.00; RMSEA = 0.00; SRMR = 0.00) and revealed full mediation effects, indicating that CEO personality influences innovation primarily through leadership. These findings suggest that leadership functions as a proximal mechanism transforming personal traits into innovative behavior, underscoring the pivotal role of organized openness and social discipline. The study contributes to understanding how CEO personality translates into organizational innovation, offering insights for leadership development and executive selection in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨CEO人格特质（基于HEXACO模型）如何通过领导力中介影响组织创新。对106家新兴市场中小微企业CEO的调查显示，组织开放性和社会纪律性通过领导力完全中介影响创新。
AI.research_question: 领导力是否中介了CEO人格特质与组织创新之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 虽然CEO人格特质与组织创新的关系被广泛提出，但连接这些构念的机制仍不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: HEXACO人格模型，领导力中介模型
AI.method: 对106家新兴市场中小微企业CEO的问卷调查，探索性因子分析，回归分析，中介模型检验
AI.findings: 组织开放性和社会纪律性显著预测创新，诚信-责任、组织开放性和社会纪律性预测领导力。领导力完全中介了人格特质对创新的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了领导力作为人格特质转化为创新行为的近端机制，强调了组织开放性和社会纪律性的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场的领导力发展和高管选拔提供见解，帮助理解CEO人格如何转化为组织创新。

title: The Impact of Human Capital on the Development of Startup Enterprises in Kosovo
affiliations: University for Business and Technology (UBT), University for Business and Technology (UBT), , University for Business and Technology (UBT) - Department of Management, Business and Economics (MBE), University for Business and Technology (UBT), University for Business and Technology (UBT) and University for Business and Technology (UBT)

detail.title: The Impact of Human Capital on the Development of Startup Enterprises in Kosovo

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: Supported by UBT College

detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to analyze the impact of human capital on the development and success of startup enterprises in Kosovo. In an economic context marked by structural challenges and a lack of sustainable investments, startups represent significant potential for job creation and long-term growth. However, their success is often determined by the level of human capital-a key component that includes the skills, knowledge, experience, and education of founders and employees. A quantitative methodology was employed in this study. Data were collected from 150 startup enterprises in Kosovo through structured questionnaires and analyzed using statistical methods via SPSS. The study measures the relationship between components of human capital (education, training, and experience) and performance indicators (revenue growth, number of employees, startup longevity). The findings indicate a strong positive correlation between the level of human capital and the development of startups. In particular, startups led by founders with higher education levels and prior managerial experience tend to achieve faster market expansion and operational sustainability. The theoretical implications of this research confirm the critical role of human capital in economic development models. Practically, the results offer valuable insights for policymakers and economic development institutions in designing training and education schemes tailored for entrepreneurs. The originality of this paper lies in its focus on Kosovo, a developing economy with unique cultural and institutional features. The study contributes to the existing literature by providing empirical evidence on the importance of human capital in determining startup success in a Balkan context.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了科索沃初创企业中人力资本对发展和成功的影响。通过定量方法调查150家初创企业，发现人力资本（教育、培训、经验）与初创企业绩效（收入增长、员工数量、企业寿命）存在显著正相关关系。
AI.research_question: 人力资本如何影响科索沃初创企业的发展和成功？
AI.motivation: 在面临结构性挑战和缺乏可持续投资的经济背景下，初创企业具有创造就业和长期增长的巨大潜力，但其成功往往取决于人力资本水平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论，包括技能、知识、经验和教育等关键组成部分对创业成功的影响。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，通过结构化问卷收集科索沃150家初创企业的数据，使用SPSS进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 人力资本水平与初创企业发展呈强正相关关系，特别是具有高等教育背景和先前管理经验的创始人领导的初创企业往往能实现更快的市场扩张和运营可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了人力资本在经济发展模型中的关键作用，为巴尔干地区背景下的创业研究提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和经济发展机构设计针对企业家的培训和教育方案提供了有价值的见解。

title: The AI Bubble and the U.S. Economy: How Long Do 'Hallucinations' Last?
affiliations: Delft University of Technology

detail.title: The AI Bubble and the U.S. Economy: How Long Do 'Hallucinations' Last?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series 240
publicationDetails.journalName: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The U.S. is undergoing an extraordinary, AI-fueled economic boom: The stock market is soaring thanks to exceptionally high valuations of AI-related tech firms, which are fueling economic growth by the hundreds of billions of U.S. dollars they are spending on data centers and other AI infrastructure. The AI investment boom is based on the belief that AI will make workers and firms significantly more productive, which will in turn boost corporate profits to unprecedented levels. But evidence is piling up that generative AI (GenAI) is failing to deliver. This paper argues that (i) we have reached "peak GenAI" in terms of current Large Language Models (LLMs); scaling (building more data centers and using more chips) will not take us further to the goal of "Artificial General Intelligence" (AGI); returns are diminishing rapidly; (ii) the AI-LLM industry and the larger U.S. economy are experiencing a speculative bubble, which is about to burst (because of the first point); and (iii) the U.S. bet the farm on a future dominated by U.S.-owned AGI, because, for geopolitical reasons, it could not afford to risk to lose the AI-race with China; this geopolitical bet on AGI is now going bad.

AI.tldr: 本文认为生成式AI已达到峰值，AI投资泡沫即将破裂，美国对AGI的地缘政治赌注正在失败
AI.research_question: 生成式AI是否已达到技术极限？AI投资泡沫是否会破裂？美国对AGI的地缘政治战略是否可行？
AI.motivation: 美国正经历AI驱动的经济繁荣，但证据表明生成式AI未能兑现承诺，投资泡沫风险日益显现

AI.method: 理论分析和实证证据评估
AI.findings: 1)生成式AI已达技术峰值，规模扩张无法实现AGI；2)AI-LLM行业存在投机泡沫；3)美国AGI地缘政治赌注失败
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI技术成熟度峰值概念，构建了AI投资泡沫分析框架，深化了技术地缘政治理论

title: Strategic CFO-Level Impact of AI in SAP FICO: From Reporting to Strategy
affiliations: Castleton commodities international

detail.title: Strategic CFO-Level Impact of AI in SAP FICO: From Reporting to Strategy
detail.abstract: The role of the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is undergoing a historic transformation, driven by the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) into financial systems such as SAP FICO. Traditionally positioned as custodians of accuracy and compliance, CFOs have often focused on retrospective reporting. However, in today's volatile business environment-marked by inflation, foreign exchange (FX) volatility, and global supply chain risks-the demand for forward-looking, data-driven decision-making has never been greater. This paper explores the strategic impact of AI on CFO-level decision-making, with a focus on scenario modeling, AI-enhanced forecasting, and the evolution of the CFO's role from reporting to strategy. It demonstrates how AI-powered scenario modeling enables CFOs to simulate complex business environments-ranging from inflationary shocks to FX fluctuationswhile predictive and prescriptive analytics within SAP FICO allow for continuous, dynamic forecasting that improves accuracy and strategic agility. The paper also highlights how AI shifts the CFO's identity from a "chief accountant" to a strategic partner and digital finance architect, guiding enterprise value creation and resilience. The study concludes that AI adoption in SAP FICO not only improves operational efficiency but also elevates the CFO's influence in enterprise strategy, governance, and innovation. For organizations navigating uncertainty, AI is no longer optional; it is a strategic imperative that redefines financial leadership in the digital era.

AI.tldr: AI和机器学习正在重塑CFO角色，从传统会计职能转向战略合作伙伴，通过SAP FICO中的场景建模和预测分析提升决策能力。
AI.research_question: AI如何影响CFO层面的战略决策制定？
AI.motivation: 在通胀、汇率波动和全球供应链风险等不确定的商业环境中，对前瞻性、数据驱动决策的需求日益增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: CFO角色转型理论、AI增强决策理论、数字金融架构理论
AI.method: 探索性研究，分析AI在SAP FICO中的应用及其对CFO决策的影响
AI.findings: AI驱动的场景建模使CFO能够模拟复杂商业环境，预测性和规范性分析提高了预测准确性和战略敏捷性
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了CFO角色转型理论，提出了AI时代CFO作为战略合作伙伴和数字金融架构师的新身份
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了AI在SAP FICO中的实施指南，帮助CFO提升战略影响力，增强企业在不确定性环境中的韧性

title: Algorithm Reliance and the Value of Information in Recommendation Systems
affiliations: City University of NY, Baruch College, Zicklin School of Business and Stanford Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Algorithm Reliance and the Value of Information in Recommendation Systems
detail.abstract: Recommendation systems are integral to modern platforms, helping users navigate vast choice sets in commerce, entertainment, and even hiring. A primary benefit of these systems is cost reduction--they save users the time and effort of gathering information and evaluating countless options. While the increasing accuracy of predictive analytics suggests a logical evolution towards fully autonomous decision systems where the algorithm makes the final choice, their adoption remains surprisingly limited. From a rational perspective, delegating the decision to such algorithms should be optimal whenever the cost of human information gathering outweighs the marginal benefit of making a more informed choice. This paper investigates the behavioral factors that explain why users often retain final decision-making authority, even when it is costly to do so. We develop a stylized model where an agent decides between delegating a choice to a basic algorithm with partial information or paying a cost to gather full information and choose optimally. We test the model's predictions with an incentivized "Hiring Game" experiment. Our results show that subjects consistently set cost thresholds for gathering information that are significantly higher than the normative benchmark, leading to lower overall payoffs. We also find that, controlling for payoffs, subjects report higher satisfaction with outcomes they chose themselves, particularly when the outcome is poor. These behaviors are primarily driven by a cognitive bias: using an incentivized elicitation method, we find that subjects systematically overestimate both the probability of the algorithm making an error and the expected loss from such an error. A second experiment designed to isolate the value of agency reveals that this overestimation of the value of information, rather than a preference for decision autonomy, is the main driver of behavior. These findings offer a behavioral explanation for the persistent reliance on costly human oversight in algorithmic systems and provide insights for designing more effective human-algorithm decision-making environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用户为何在算法推荐系统中保留最终决策权，即使这样做成本高昂。研究发现，用户高估算法错误概率和损失，导致信息获取成本阈值设置过高，降低整体收益。
AI.research_question: 为什么用户即使在成本高昂的情况下也倾向于保留最终决策权，而不是完全委托给算法？
AI.motivation: 尽管预测分析准确性不断提高，但完全自主的算法决策系统采用仍然有限，这与理性视角下的最优决策相矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、委托决策理论、信息价值评估偏差
AI.method: 开发理论模型，并通过激励性"招聘游戏"实验进行测试，使用激励性引出方法测量认知偏差
AI.findings: 受试者设置的信息获取成本阈值显著高于规范基准，导致整体收益降低；在控制收益的情况下，受试者对自主选择的结果满意度更高；主要驱动因素是系统性地高估算法错误概率和预期损失
AI.theory_contributions: 为算法系统中持续依赖成本高昂的人类监督提供了行为解释，揭示了信息价值高估的认知偏差
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计更有效的人机决策环境提供见解，帮助优化推荐系统和算法决策的采用

detail.abstract:
In this study, we suggest that crowding-out effects are unlikely when incentivizing behaviors that we refer to as mixed-motive—that is, behaviors motivated by both self-interest and prosociality. Vaccination is the prominent example we analyze: people vaccinate both to protect their own health and to contribute to herd immunity by protecting others.

Building on signaling theory, we assume that people derive utility from signaling their prosociality. Incentives can crowd out prosocial motivation when they block the opportunity to send a clear prosocial signal, as in purely prosocial behaviors like charitable giving. Mixed-motive behaviors differ: they never allow for a clean prosocial signal in the first place, because self-interest is always a plausible motive. As such, providing financial incentives does not further constrain signaling opportunities, and we therefore predicted no crowding-out effects to emerge when incentivizing mixed-motive behaviors. Our experimental study supports this prediction.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了激励对混合动机行为的影响，发现不会产生挤出效应。混合动机行为同时包含自利和利他动机（如疫苗接种），由于本身就无法发出纯粹的利他信号，因此提供经济激励不会进一步限制信号传递机会。
AI.research_question: 激励混合动机行为是否会产生挤出效应？
AI.motivation: 传统研究认为经济激励会挤出利他动机，但混合动机行为（如疫苗接种）同时包含自利和利他动机，可能不会产生挤出效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论 - 人们从传递利他信号中获得效用，激励可能通过限制信号传递机会而挤出利他动机。
AI.method: 实验研究
AI.findings: 实验支持预测：激励混合动机行为不会产生挤出效应
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了激励对利他动机影响的理论，区分了纯粹利他行为和混合动机行为的不同机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计激励措施提供了理论指导，特别是在公共卫生领域如疫苗接种激励。

title: Bilingual/Localization Strategies in Latin American Expansion: Four Cases

detail.title: Bilingual/Localization Strategies in Latin American Expansion: Four Cases
detail.abstract: In Latin America, language proficiency is a critical business imperative, not a courtesy. Companies that neglect Spanish-language capability experience significant market failures, while those pursuing comprehensive localization capture cross-border demand and achieve sustainable growth.  This study examines four multinational corporations to demonstrate how language strategy directly influences market performance. Golden Dragon, a Chinese manufacturer, encountered substantial operational challenges in Mexico due to linguistic isolation. Best Buy's Spanish-language e-commerce platform generated substantial engagement and revenue gains. Uber Eats' literal translation approach in Colombia undermined user adoption, whereas Netflix's investment in Spanish and Portuguese content and localized interfaces drove rapid subscriber expansion.  Drawing on industry reports and case studies from September 2017 to September 2025, supplemented by foundational examples, our findings reveal that strategic localization functions as competitive infrastructure. Organizations that proactively address linguistic needs, employ professional translation, develop bilingual teams, and deliver culturally equivalent experiences achieve superior operational, financial, and reputational outcomes. Conversely, inadequate localization correlates with misunderstandings, poor adoption, and diminished revenue.  While language alone does not determine success, strategic attention to localization provides organizations with both protective and growth-oriented advantages in Latin American expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言战略对拉美市场表现的影响，发现战略性本地化（包括专业翻译、双语团队和文化等效体验）能带来运营、财务和声誉优势，而本地化不足则导致误解、采用率低和收入减少。
AI.research_question: 语言战略如何直接影响企业在拉丁美洲市场的表现？
AI.motivation: 在拉丁美洲，语言能力是关键的商业需求而非礼貌，忽视西班牙语能力的公司面临重大市场失败，而追求全面本地化的公司则能抓住跨境需求实现可持续增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略性本地化作为竞争性基础设施的理论框架
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析四家跨国公司在拉丁美洲的实践经验，结合行业报告和2017-2025年的案例研究
AI.findings:
1. 语言隔离导致运营挑战（如Golden Dragon在墨西哥）
2. 西班牙语电商平台显著提升参与度和收入（如Best Buy）
3. 字面翻译方法削弱用户采用（如Uber Eats在哥伦比亚）
4. 投资本地化内容和界面驱动快速增长（如Netflix）
AI.theory_contributions: 将战略性本地化概念化为竞争性基础设施，为语言战略理论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供具体的本地化策略：专业翻译、双语团队开发、文化等效体验，帮助企业在拉美扩张中获得保护和增长优势

title: From Vibe-Coding to Vibe-Governance: How AI Is Rewriting the Rules of Power
affiliations: Better Regulation Delivery Office — BRDO

detail.title: From Vibe-Coding to Vibe-Governance: How AI Is Rewriting the Rules of Power
detail.abstract: This paper introduces and coins the conceptual framework of Vibe-Governance-how conversational AI restructures access and power in public policy. Just as "vibe-coding" made software creation accessible through natural-language interfaces, Vibe-Governance applies the same translation layer to policymaking, lobbying, advocacy, and justice. I define related terms-Vibe-Policymaking, Vibe-Lobbying, Vibe-Advocacy, and Vibe-Justice-and ground them in Ukraine-based pilots: AI-assisted court-decision analysis, legislative monitoring, EU directive alignment, and policy alerts. The central claim is dual: (1) conversational interfaces widen participation and compress policy cycles by making institutions explainable and editable in plain language; (2) without guardrails, they risk widening equity gaps, amplifying bias, and weakening deliberation. I propose practical oversight principles-traceability logs, human-in-the-loop review, inclusion budgets, option-set generation, and impact audits-to govern AI-enabled governance. The contribution is a clear vocabulary, a practice-grounded framework, and an agenda for building governance at thought speed without sacrificing legitimacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"氛围治理"概念框架，探讨对话式AI如何重构公共政策中的访问权与权力分配。通过乌克兰的实践案例，展示了AI在司法决策分析、立法监督等领域的应用，并提出了确保AI治理合法性的监管原则。
AI.research_question: 对话式AI如何重构公共政策中的访问权和权力分配？
AI.motivation: 随着"氛围编码"使软件创建通过自然语言界面变得可访问，作者希望将同样的翻译层应用于政策制定、游说、倡导和司法领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 氛围治理、氛围政策制定、氛围游说、氛围倡导、氛围司法
AI.method: 基于乌克兰的试点项目：AI辅助的法院决策分析、立法监督、欧盟指令对齐和政策警报
AI.findings: 对话式界面通过使机构可解释和可编辑来扩大参与并压缩政策周期；但若无防护措施，可能扩大公平差距、放大偏见并削弱审议过程
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了清晰的词汇表、基于实践的框架，以及在不牺牲合法性的前提下以思维速度构建治理的议程
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了实用的监督原则：可追溯性日志、人在回路审查、包容性预算、选项集生成和影响审计

title: Corporate Social Responsibility and Consumer Purchase Intention: The Mediating Role of Brand Equity — A Systematic Review (2018–2025)
affiliations: Bahauddin Zakariya University and Bahauddin Zakariya University

detail.title: Corporate Social Responsibility and Consumer Purchase Intention: The Mediating Role of Brand Equity — A Systematic Review (2018–2025)
detail.abstract: This study systematically reviews research published between 2018 and 2025 to examine how Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) influences consumer purchase intention through the mediating role of brand equity. Drawing on 28 empirical and conceptual studies sourced from Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar, and SSRN, the review applies a thematic synthesis approach integrating cognitive, affective, and contextual perspectives. Findings reveal that CSR enhances consumer purchase intention primarily by strengthening brand image and brand equity, with authenticity, brand-CSR fit, and cultural context serving as critical boundary conditions. Authentic and value-driven CSR initiatives foster consumer trust, emotional attachment, and moral legitimacy-key components of brand equity that drive favorable purchase decisions. Conversely, perceived opportunism or greenwashing weakens these effects and may erode brand capital. The review highlights persistent methodological homogeneity, overreliance on cross-sectional surveys, and limited exploration of digital CSR communication. The study contributes a conceptual framework clarifying the CSR-brandbehavior mechanism and proposes a future research agenda emphasizing longitudinal, experimental, and cross-cultural designs. The findings offer strategic insights for marketers seeking to align ethical responsibility with brand value creation and consumer loyalty.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统回顾2018-2025年间发表的文献，探讨企业社会责任如何通过品牌资产的中介作用影响消费者购买意愿。研究发现CSR主要通过增强品牌形象和品牌资产来提升购买意愿，真实性、品牌-CSR契合度和文化背景是关键边界条件。
AI.research_question: 企业社会责任如何通过品牌资产的中介作用影响消费者购买意愿？
AI.motivation: 理解CSR影响消费者行为的机制，为企业将伦理责任与品牌价值创造相结合提供战略洞见
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合认知、情感和情境视角的主题综合方法，基于品牌资产理论
AI.method: 对28项实证和概念研究进行系统文献回顾，采用主题综合方法分析Scopus、Web of Science、ScienceDirect、Google Scholar和SSRN数据库
AI.findings: CSR通过增强品牌形象和品牌资产提升购买意愿；真实性、品牌-CSR契合度和文化背景是关键边界条件；真实的CSR举措促进消费者信任、情感依恋和道德合法性；机会主义或漂绿行为会削弱这些效应
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了阐明CSR-品牌行为机制的概念框架，为未来研究提供纵向、实验和跨文化设计的研究议程
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销人员将伦理责任与品牌价值创造和消费者忠诚度相结合提供战略洞见

title: AI-Driven Leapfrogging in Higher Education: A Strategic Framework for Equity, Innovation, and Academic Transformation

detail.title: AI-Driven Leapfrogging in Higher Education: A Strategic Framework for Equity, Innovation, and Academic Transformation
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming higher education by enabling personalized learning, streamlining administrative tasks, and enhancing global access to academic resources. This paper investigates how AI-driven technological leapfrogging allows institutions-particularly in underresourced regions-to bypass conventional development phases by directly adopting advanced AI systems. Using a mixed-methods approach, including case studies from Rwanda, India, and the UAE, this study explores how AI fosters equity, increases faculty efficiency, and enhances student engagement. The findings indicate that AI-integrated learning systems significantly improve academic outcomes, with 78% of students reporting performance gains and 85% of faculty citing improved efficiency. However, challenges persist, including data privacy concerns, algorithmic bias, and unequal access to AI tools. The study emphasizes the need for ethical AI frameworks and inclusive policies to ensure sustainable integration. By framing AI as both a catalyst for innovation and a tool for equitable academic advancement, this research contributes to the discourse on educational technology and policy reform in global higher education.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能如何通过技术跨越帮助高等教育机构，特别是在资源匮乏地区，直接采用先进的AI系统，从而促进教育公平、提高教师效率和增强学生参与度。研究发现AI集成学习系统显著改善学业成果，但也面临数据隐私、算法偏见和工具获取不平等等挑战。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的技术跨越如何使高等教育机构，特别是资源匮乏地区的机构，能够绕过传统发展阶段，直接采用先进的AI系统？
AI.motivation: AI正在通过个性化学习、简化行政任务和增强全球学术资源获取来改变高等教育。本文旨在研究AI驱动的技术跨越如何帮助机构，特别是在资源匮乏地区，直接采用先进的AI系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术跨越理论、教育技术整合理论、教育公平理论
AI.method: 混合方法，包括来自卢旺达、印度和阿联酋的案例研究
AI.findings: AI集成学习系统显著改善学业成果，78%的学生报告成绩提升，85%的教师表示效率提高。但存在数据隐私、算法偏见和AI工具获取不平等等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI框架化为创新催化剂和公平学术进步工具，为教育技术和全球高等教育政策改革的话语做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要伦理AI框架和包容性政策，以确保可持续整合，为高等教育机构提供实践指导。
